title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
World Corp Digital is seeking a highly capable, hands-on Senior Full-Stack Developer to work directly with our start-up company in designing, building, improving, and maintaining modern software products.



We are building a growing ecosystem of:



* Business applications

* Internal management systems

* Public-facing websites

* Online platforms and marketplaces

* Customer and administrative portals



The successful developer will help us d
 how sites and apps should be structured, which technologies should be used, how systems should work together, and how ideas can be converted into reliable, maintainable software.



We want a developer who can understand what the business needs, evaluate the available options, and recommend the most suitable framework, architecture, database, hosting approach, and development structure for each project.



Important work-location information



The application process, technical assessment, and interviews will all be conducted online. Applicants will not be required to attend a physical office during recruitment and until February 2027.



However, this position is not intended to remain permanently remote. The successful candidate is expected to relocate to a company location in Central America around March 2027 and work from a company office after relocation.



The exact country, city, immigration arrangements, office details, and housing information will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates during the initial interview and before they are asked to complete the technical assessment.



Please apply only if you are genuinely willing to consider long-term international relocation.



Compensation and relocation package

The proposed package includes:



* USD $3,000 monthly base compensation

* Company-provided 2BR apartment

* Company-paid electricity and basic utilities

* Company-paid internet and television service

* Medical insurance

* Transportation allowance

* One company-paid RT flight to the Philippines each year

* Paid vacation leave

* Long-term opportunity to help shape the company’s software and technology direction



The employee will generally remain responsible for food and personal expenses.



Complete compensation, tax treatment, leave conditions, immigration assistance, flight eligibility, housing rules, and other benefits will be stated in the final written employment agreement.



What you will be responsible for

Your responsibilities will generally include:



* Working with management to understand business requirements, priorities, and long-term objectives.

* Turning business ideas into clear software requirements and practical development plans.

* Recommending the most appropriate technology stack and architecture for each project.

* Designing and building complete software applications from concept through release.

* Developing both user-facing and administrative functionality.

* Connecting applications with databases, external services, APIs, and business systems.

* Reviewing existing software and determining what should be retained, improved, refactored, or replaced.

* Identifying technical risks, security weaknesses, performance problems, and incomplete workflows.

* Writing clean, maintainable, secure, and well-structured code.

* Testing and verifying applications before release.

* Diagnosing and resolving technical problems.

* Maintaining documentation so systems can be understood and supported over time.

* Helping establish consistent engineering and quality standards.

* Monitoring released products and responding responsibly when problems occur.

* Providing management with honest technical recommendations, realistic estimates, and early warnings about risks.

* Taking ownership of assigned products and following work through to a verified result.



The exact balance of frontend, backend, database, architecture, integration, and infrastructure work will depend on the needs of each product.



Technology and framework approach



We expect the successful developer to be highly capable with modern, widely adopted technologies used to build professional web applications, SaaS products, marketplaces, business systems, and digital platforms.



You should be able to evaluate technology based on:



* Product requirements

* Expected users and scale

* Development speed

* Security

* Maintainability

* Performance

* Reliability

* Integration requirements

* Hosting and operating cost

* Availability of long-term support

* Ease of hiring or transferring the system to another qualified developer



The strongest applicant may specialize in a particular technology while still demonstrating enough breadth to choose the right solution for different products.



AI-assisted development

World Corp Digital uses modern AI-assisted development tools and expects the successful developer to adopt them responsibly.



Experience with tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, v0, or similar platforms is valuable.



The successful developer should be able to:



* Use AI to accelerate research, planning, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.

* Give AI tools clear and effective technical instructions.

* Review AI-generated code critically.

* Verify that generated code actually works.

* Detect insecure, incomplete, fabricated, or unnecessarily complicated implementations.

* Correct AI-generated mistakes instead of accepting them blindly.

* Understand and explain the code they approve.

* Use AI to increase productivity without sacrificing engineering quality.

* Make independent technical decisions when AI recommendations are unsuitable.

* Take full professional responsibility for the final result.



We need a developer with a real coding foundation who can use AI as a powerful engineering tool.



Required technical qualifications

Applicants should have:



* A strong foundation in software development and computer programming.

* Substantial hands-on experience building real software applications.

* Experience taking a software product from requirements through development, testing, release, and maintenance.

* The ability to work across both frontend and backend development.

* A sound understanding of application architecture.

* Experience working with databases, APIs, authentication, integrations, and cloud-hosted applications.

* The ability to analyze requirements and recommend an appropriate technical approach.

* Strong debugging and problem-solving ability.

* Understanding of software security, data protection, access control, and safe development practices.

* Experience testing and verifying software before release.

* Experience maintaining or improving software built by another developer.

* Familiarity with professional source-control and collaborative development practices.

* Ability to write readable, maintainable, and documented code.

* Ability to communicate technical matters clearly in written and spoken English.

* Willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies when they are the best choice for a product.



We prefer applicants with at least 5 years of professional software-development experience, but years alone will not determine selection.



Applicants with fewer years may still be considered if they can demonstrate strong production experience, technical depth, independent ownership, and high-quality work.



A university degree is helpful but not mandatory. Demonstrated ability and real production experience are more important.



The type of developer we are looking for

We want someone who:



* Is still actively writing and reviewing code.

* Understands both technical implementation and business purpose.

* Can independently investigate unfamiliar systems.

* Makes decisions based on evidence and product needs.

* Does not force every project into the same framework.

* Can recognize when an existing solution should be improved rather than rebuilt.

* Takes responsibility for results.

* Communicates problems and delays early.

* Does not conceal mistakes.

* Can explain complicated technical matters to nontechnical management.

* Can disagree professionally when a shortcut would create unacceptable risk.

* Documents important decisions and procedures.

* Accepts feedback and can revise an incorrect technical position.

* Works independently without becoming unresponsive.

* Is interested in a serious, stable, long-term position.

* Is willing to prepare responsibly for international relocation.



How to apply

For this initial recruitment stage, apply directly through here on OnlineJobs.ph

Use this subject line:

WCD Senior Developer – [Your Full Name]



Begin your application message with this exact sentence:



"I have read the complete World Corp Digital job post."



Then number and answer all the following questions:



1. How many total years of professional software-development experience do you have?

   Also state how many of those years involved regular hands-on coding.



2. What are your three strongest technologies, frameworks, programming languages, or technical specialties?

   For each one, briefly describe how you have used it in a real project.



3. What type of software or application development would you consider your strongest area or forte?

   Examples may include SaaS, business systems, marketplaces, mobile applications, data platforms, automation, backend systems, user interfaces, integrations, or another area.



4. Provide links to your GitHub, GitLab, portfolio, LinkedIn profile, personal website, or relevant work samples.

   If your work is confidential, explain what sanitized work you can demonstrate during the hiring process.



5. Briefly describe the strongest software product you personally built or substantially maintained.

   State what the product did, which parts you personally handled, and the most difficult technical problem you solved.



6. Are you willing to complete an online technical assessment if shortlisted?

   Answer yes or no.



7. Are you willing to consider relocating to Central America around March 2027 for a long-term office-based position?

   Answer yes or no.



8. Are you comfortable with the proposed USD $3,000 monthly base compensation and the relocation benefits described in this posting?  Answer yes, no, or explain what you need clarified.



9. How do you currently use AI-assisted development tools?

    Name the tools you use and explain how you verify the code or recommendations they generate.



Attach your updated resume or CV to your application.



Applications that:



* Do not use the required subject line,

* Do not begin with the required sentence,

* Do not answer the numbered questions, or

* Consist only of a generic message such as “I am interested”



may not be reviewed.





We welcome applications from experienced developers who want to help build meaningful software, make sound technical decisions, and grow with World Corp Digital over the long term.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor Wanted — Faceless Geopolitical/Financial History Channel



We're launching a new faceless YouTube documentary channel on geopolitical and financial history — how debt, empire, and power shaped events like the Balfour Declaration or the carve-up of the Ottoman Empire. Episodes run 25–45 min, AI-narrated (we handle scripting and voice — you don't).



Style reference: Uncover History — 



You'll receive per episode

Locked script

Finished narration audio

Visual/sourcing sheet with shot-by-shot notes and copyright-tagged (????????????) archival leads





Your job

Edit that package into a publish-ready video in Uncover History's style:





Archival photos, maps, and documents animated with Ken Burns pans — nothing static

Animated maps for shifting borders/territory

"Document reveal" overlays for treaties/letters

Financial data overlays (debt figures, timelines, charts)

Figure cards for key people, chapter title cards, burned-in subtitles

Sepia grade for archival material, cooler for modern segments

New visual beat every 4–8 seconds





Sourcing rule: no scraped YouTube clips, ever. Licensed stills/archive footage (Getty, British Pathé, ITN, Reuters/AP Archive, BBC Motion Gallery) or original recreation only.



To apply



Send a portfolio of long-form history/finance documentary edits, your typical turnaround and rate for a 30-min episode, and (ideally) a short sample cut. Premiere Pro or Resolve + After Effects required. Ongoing recurring work.

title: Sales Operations
description:
Sales Operations Manager for The Business of Dance - 

Remote full time independent contractor



Compensation: $1,000 monthly base plus 0.5% of cash collected

Payment Terms: Invoices are due on the 1st of each month and paid no later than the 7th of each month

Start Date: Hiring immediately



We are looking to hire a highly organized, proactive, and detail driven Sales Operations Manager to support the day to day operations of our sales department.



We are looking to hire right away, so immediate response is greatly appreciated.



This is not a closing role. You will not be responsible for closing sales. We already have appointment setters and closers who handle the sales conversations and closing process.



This role is focused on communication, systems, tracking, reporting, accountability, and cash collection support. You will help make sure the sales department is operating smoothly behind the scenes by ensuring that leads are tracked properly, notes are updated, appointments are monitored, sales data is accurate, overdue payments are followed up on, and nothing falls through the cracks.



This is the person who helps keep the sales machine clean, organized, and running properly.



Compensation



This role pays a $1,000 monthly base plus 0.5% of cash collected.



Our business typically generates between $50,000 and $150,000 per month, so here is what compensation can look like based on cash collected:



$50,000 collected = $250 commission + $1,000 base = $1,250 total

$75,000 collected = $375 commission + $1,000 base = $1,375 total

$100,000 collected = $500 commission + $1,000 base = $1,500 total

$150,000 collected = $750 commission + $1,000 base = $1,750 total



This role is ideal for someone who is motivated by results and understands that stronger follow up, cleaner systems, and better collections directly impact compensation.



Main Purpose of the Role



The main purpose of this role is to support the sales department operationally, not to sell.

You will work alongside appointment setters and closers to make sure:



sales systems are functioning properly

leads and clients are tracked correctly

notes, tags, and statuses are up to date

appointments and follow up are monitored

sales data is accurate and accounted for

outstanding invoices and overdue balances are followed up on

closers are supported with cash collection and accounts receivable follow up

leadership has visibility into the numbers and performance of the department



Key Responsibilities



Sales Department Operations

Ensure the sales systems are operating properly on a daily basis

Keep the sales pipeline organized and up to date

Make sure leads, prospects, and clients are properly tracked inside our systems

Monitor movement through the pipeline

Ensure notes, tags, statuses, and tasks are updated accurately

Identify operational gaps, missed follow up, and breakdowns in the system

Help maintain clean internal processes and accountability



Sales Data and Reporting



Track and monitor all key sales data

Maintain accurate reporting across pipeline activity, show rates, unpaid balances, cash collected, and outstanding receivables

Ensure data is current, organized, and accounted for

Provide weekly and monthly reporting to leadership

Help leadership make decisions based on real time numbers and clean data

Cash Collection and Accounts Receivable Support

Assist closers with collecting cash after the sale

Track outstanding invoices and overdue balances

Follow up with clients regarding unpaid invoices in a professional and timely manner through
, text, and phone when needed

Make periodic phone calls to customers to follow up on accounts receivable and overdue balances

Keep accurate records of payment activity and communication

Monitor payments and payment history through Stripe

Help reduce accounts receivable and improve monthly cash collection

Coordinate with leadership regarding payment plans and collection priorities



Team Communication and Accountability

Communicate clearly with appointment setters, closers, leadership, and other tea
mbers

Help hold the team accountable for updating notes, tasks, and statuses

Support strong internal communication and smooth handoff between departments

Make sure nothing important slips through the cracks



Schedule and Availability



This is a full time role of approximately 40 hours per week, typically spread across 6 days per week, averaging about 6.5 to 7 hours per day.



Working hours are flexible within our approved time window. We are open to discussing either a split shift schedule, where hours are divided into two shorter work blocks with a sleep break in between, or a continuous shift schedule, where the candidate works one consistent block of approximately 6.5 to 7 hours per day.



The exact schedule can be discussed based on what works best for both the company and the candidate, as long as the role is properly covered and responsibilities are handled consistently.



Sample Split Shift Options for Philippines Based Tea
mbers



Option 1

10:00 PM to 1:00 AM PHT

Sleep / break

9:00 AM to 1:00 PM PHT



This equals:

6:00 AM to 9:00 AM PT

5:00 PM to 9:00 PM PT



Option 2

11:00 PM to 2:00 AM PHT

Sleep / break

9:00 AM to 1:00 PM PHT



This equals:

7:00 AM to 10:00 AM PT

5:00 PM to 9:00 PM PT



Sample Continuous Shift Option for Philippines Based Tea
mbers



Option 3

6:00 AM to 1:00 PM PHT



This equals:

2:00 PM to 9:00 PM PT



These are just sample schedule options. We are open to discussing the exact structure, whether split shift or continuous, as long as the candidate can maintain strong focus, reliability, responsiveness, and consistent coverage.



Commitment Expectations



Because this is a full time role, we are looking for someone who is fully committed and able to give this position their full focus and energy.



This role is not ideal for someone juggling multiple jobs, split priorities, or heavy outside commitments that may affect responsiveness, consistency, or performance. We are looking for someone dependable, engaged, and available to fully support the team.



Training



There will be one week of unpaid training to learn the basics of the role, systems, workflow, and expectations before officially stepping into the position.



This training period is important so the right candidate can properly understand how our company operates and feel confident using our tools and processes.



Tools We Use



You should be comfortable learning and working inside the following tools:



Zoom for team calls

Slack for team communication

Calendly to book appointments

Quo as our business phone and text line

Notion as our CRM and sales tracker

ManyChat for DM conversations

Fathom as an AI note taker for Zoom calls

ChatGPT for research and written communication

Gmail for
 communication

Stripe as our payment processor

Apploye for team tracking and productivity monitoring



You do not need to be an expert in every tool on day one, but you do need to be tech comfortable, fast to learn, and able to work efficiently across multiple platforms.



Ideal Candidate



You are:

highly organized and detail oriented

proactive and self managed

strong with follow up and communication

comfortable with numbers, reporting, and tracking

confident speaking with customers on the phone when needed

confident handling payment related follow up professionally

reliable, responsive, and results driven

motivated by helping the department run smoothly and improving cash collection

someone who enjoys operations 



Requirements



Experience in sales operations, client support, accounts receivable, collections, administration, or a similar role

Strong written and spoken English skills are required

North American accent strongly preferred

Must have your own computer

Must have reliable high speed internet

Must be comfortable using team tracking software

Strong communication and follow through

Comfortable making periodic phone calls to customers regarding outstanding balances

Ability to keep multiple moving parts organized

Comfort working remotely and using digital tools every day

Ability to maintain professionalism when communicating with prospects, clients, and tea
mbers



Payment Terms

Invoice due on the 1st of each month

Paid no later than the 7th of each month

We pay through Wise

Payment can be sent through direct international transfer into your Filipino bank account

Transfers typically take approximately one business day to process



How to Apply



Please respond with the following:

your experience

your qualifications

your skills

your tech knowledge

your preferred working schedule



We are hiring immediately, so fast responses are greatly appreciated.

title: Supply Chain & Project Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 
/share/base/form/shrlg5pFuw8LjdqeGFOVZLD9i0d

(please do not submit application again if you have already done so)



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in USA and Singapore. Our supply chain span across 4 countries, 10+ suppliers and 3 warehouses. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino tea
mbers and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for a hands-on Supply Chain & Project Manager to support the Head of Supply Chain in executing Crafti's day-to-day operations - supplier coordination, production tracking and inventory management.



This role requires someone who is highly responsive, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-moving environment. Supply chain runs around the clock. Our suppliers operate across time zones, and updates can come at any hour. This is not a typical Monday to Friday, clock-in clock-out job.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Enjoy speaking with suppliers to ensure that they are able to deliver items on time

- Can process high volumes of information from multiple channels simultaneously and translate them into clear next actions, without needing someone to connect the dots

- Like to push projects forward and move things along rather than wait to be told what's next

- Enjoy keeping detailed records and staying organised



Do not apply if:



- Your supply chain experience is limited to admin support without direct supplier contact

- You are uncomfortable learning and using new software tools and AI independently

- You are not comfortable working outside standard hours when suppliers or shipments require it

- Your written English is not business-professional level



What You'll Do



- Supplier Communication & Coordination — monitor all communication channels daily and respond to supplier and team updates with urgency. Chase production status updates from 10+ suppliers at the same time



- Inventory Allocation — manage production splits across sales channels



- Production Tracking — update production records in our tracking database with same-day accuracy. Coordinate manufacturing schedules, flag any production delays or risks to the team proactively.



- Purchase Order & Manufacturing Order Management — create and track POs and MOs in MRPeasy.



- QC Process Management — prepare QC quote requests with QC checklists attached, coordinate QC inspections and review defect documentation



- Shipping Coordination — prepare transfer requests and coordinate with the logistics team to ensure products move from production to warehouses in Singapore and the US on schedule.



- Inventory Reporting — prepare monthly inventory reports, action low-stock items, and complete month-end reconciliation



What We Are Looking For:



Skills:



- 2+ years in supply chain, operations, or logistics at a product company

- Experience managing active supplier relationships

- Responsive and comfortable across multiple communication platforms simultaneously (WhatsApp,
, Wechat)

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with Tech tools and AI



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- High urgency and ownership - today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done no matter what

- Proactive Communicator - if I foresee something may be wrong, I will highlight as soon as possible

- Adaptable - I embrace new tools, new processes and AI; and I want to keep improving

- Has Opinions - I want to suggest a better way



Details



This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 70,000 – 130,000 per month (based on experience)



Commitment: Full-time, Philippine business hours (Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm PHT) with flexibility for supplier updates outside standard hours)

description:
We're a fast-growing AI software company working with hundreds of e-commerce brands and agencies, and we're looking for a sharp, fast Video, Content and Graphic Editor to join us long-term as a contractor.

This is a steady role with consistent weekly work, not a one-off gig. If you're reliable, take pride in your craft, and want a long-term home with an ambitious company, read on.

About Us



We build AI tools that help e-commerce brands grow profitably. Our product is taking off and we need help producing the volume of content that comes with it: short-form videos, founder clips, customer stories, product demos, ad creative, social graphics, landing page imagery, and event collateral.

What You'll Do

Video



Edit short-form video content (15 to 90 seconds) for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and X

Edit longer-form content (3 to 10 minutes) including founder talks, webinars, customer interviews, and product walkthroughs

Add captions, b-roll, motion graphics, sound design, and on-brand transitions

Cut down recorded calls, demos, and webinars into multiple short clips

Resize and reformat content for different platforms



Graphic and image



Design and edit social graphics, carousels, and ad creative for LinkedIn, Instagram, and X

Produce landing page imagery, hero graphics, partner co-branded assets, and event collateral

Retouch and edit photography for use across web, social, and ads

Build and adapt thumbnails for YouTube and short-form

Create simple infographics, charts, and visual breakdowns from data we provide

Light motion graphics and simple animations using our templates



General



Organise raw footage, project files, and exports in our shared drive

Turn around fast. Many edits will need same-day or next-day delivery



About You



2+ years editing short-form social video and producing graphic content for brands, agencies, creators, or SaaS companies

Strong portfolio across both video and graphic work that proves you have taste. Send links to your best work

Fluent in Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects (basic is fine), Photoshop, and either Illustrator or Figma

Comfortable with captioning tools (CapCut, Submagic, Descript)

Strong English. You'll be working with English-language scripts and customer content and you need to catch errors and understand context

Reliable internet, your own machine, and able to handle 4K footage

Meta Ads Manager

Google Workspace

Canva

Every campaign launches on time.

Nothing falls through the cracks.

Leadership never has to chase tea
mbers for updates or deliverables.

Every launch receives a complete QA review before going live.

Marketing SOPs are continuously updated and improved.

The marketing team stays organized, accountable, and aligned.

Leadership spends time making decisions—not managing projects.

Exceptionally organized with outstanding attention to detail.

Strong project management and operational skills.

Excellent communication and follow-up abilities.

Comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Naturally proactive—you don't wait to be asked.

Passionate about building systems and improving processes.

Excited to work in a fast-growing ecommerce brand where no two days are the same.

title: Content & Brand Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Type: Full-time, 35-40 hrs/week

Pay: $3.50-$4.00/hr to start, with a pay increase after 90 days as you settle into the role and take on full ownership of responsibilities



About the Role



I'm a full-time content creator and business owner managing brand partnerships and affiliate programs across TikTok, Instagram,
, Pinterest, and YouTube. As the business grows, I'm bringing on a dedicated VA to own editing, account health, and day-to-day operations. This will allow me to focus my time on securing new brand partnerships, expanding revenue streams, and scaling the business strategically. I provide the raw content and full training on formatting, text-on-screen style, and captions, so you won't be guessing. You'll turn raw footage into polished, on-brand, ready-to-post material while keeping every moving piece organized behind the scenes.



This role starts with a 90-day trial period to make sure it's a good fit on both sides, with the intention of it becoming an ongoing, long-term position.



Key Responsibilities



Video & Photo Editing



-Edit raw video footage into finished short-form content using CapCut, following provided formatting guides for text overlays, captions, and style

-Edit photos in Canva for affiliate content. This is just as important as video editing, so strong photo skills are required

-Edit content for ShopMy affiliate videos

-Maintain a steady, ready-to-post content queue





Account Health & Organic Engagement



-Actively scroll and engage on assigned accounts daily to maintain authentic, active account status

-Like, comment, and interact with niche-relevant content to support algorithm performance and account credibility

-I'll provide specific keywords and hashtags to search on certain accounts to keep engagement targeted and on-niche

-Follow a consistent engagement cadence (2-3 sessions of 20-30 minutes daily) that reflects genuine, non-automated activity





Operations & Time Management



-Track deliverables and deadlines across 6 UGC brand partnerships, 2 TikTok Shop brands, and Mavely/ShopMy affiliate content

-Maintain a running content calendar and proactively flag upcoming deadlines

-Send a brief daily report (what was completed, what's in progress, anything that needs input)

-Participate in two weekly check-in calls to review progress, priorities, and any open questions

-Provide a weekly summary of completed work and outstanding items





Content Compliance



Review captions and hashtags against TikTok Community Guidelines prior to posting

Flag any language that could be read as a medical claim, pricing mention, or absolute statement





Tools You'll Use



CapCut, Canva, Google Drive/Docs/Sheets, Google Calendar, 
, Slack, TikTok, Instagram,
, Pinterest, YouTube, 
, Amazon Influencer, Mavely, ShopMy, TikTok Shop Creator Center, Linktree, Zoom/Google Meet



What I'm Looking For



-1+ year of experience editing short-form video (CapCut) and photos (Canva). Please include samples of both

-Strong written and spoken English required

-Available at least 4-5 hours of overlap with Arizona, USA time (MST) for daily reporting and weekly check-in calls

-Reliable high-speed internet and a computer capable of running CapCut smoothly

-Strong time management and organizational skills

-Proactive communication style. Comfortable flagging issues before they become urgent

-Willing and able to learn brand-specific formatting guidelines with training provided

-Experience with affiliate marketing (Amazon, Mavely, ShopMy) or UGC content is a strong plus





To Apply



Please include 2-3 samples of past video and photo edits, along with a brief note on how you personally manage multiple deadlines across several ongoing projects.

title: TikTok Ads Manager & Influencer Specialist
description:
We’re Not Hiring Someone to “Post on TikTok.” We’re Hiring Someone Who Can Turn Creators, Content, and Paid Ads Into Growth.



PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.



Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period in USD, based on experience

Pay Timing: Paid once every 2 weeks. 80 hours per period, agreed upon at hire

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time | Long-term

Team Scope: Supports paid media, influencer marketing, creative, and ecommerce teams across multiple brands



Why This Role Exists

TikTok moves quickly.

Creative gets tired. Trends change. Creators miss deadlines. Campaign performance can shift overnight.



At EcomIgnyte, we work with ecommerce brands that need someone who can manage TikTok advertising while also building a consistent pipeline of creators and UGC content.



We’re hiring a TikTok Ads Manager & Influencer Specialist to launch and optimize TikTok campaigns, find strong creators, coordinate content, manage Spark Ads, and help turn creator videos into paid advertising assets.



This role exists so:

-TikTok campaigns are launched and managed correctly

-Budgets and performance are monitored consistently

-Strong creatives are identified and tested

-Influencer outreach feels personal

-Creator conversations and deadlines stay organized

-Spark Ads permissions and content usage rights are secured

-Performance insights are shared with the creative team

-TikTok becomes a repeatable ecommerce growth channel



This is not about chasing views.

This is about turning TikTok attention into measurable results.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

You will spend most of your time managing TikTok campaigns, reviewing performance, researching creators, coordinating UGC, and keeping campaigns organized.



As a TikTok Ads Manager & Influencer Specialist, you will:

-Build, launch, and optimize campaigns inside TikTok Ads Manager

-Manage budgets, audiences, campaign structure, and creative testing

-Monitor spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and creative performance

-Identify ads that should be scaled, revised, replaced, or paused

-Launch and manage Spark Ads

-Coordinate Spark Ads authorization codes and content usage rights

-Research TikTok creators, UGC creators, affiliates, and influencers

-Identify creators who fit each brand’s audience, product, and voice

-Write personalized outreach and follow-up messages

-Coordinate gifted, paid, affiliate, and UGC partnerships

-Manage creator briefs, deadlines, revisions, and deliverables

-Track creator rates, contact details, permissions, content, and campaign status

-Review creator videos for hooks, pacing, clarity, and paid advertising potential

-Share creative performance insights with designers, editors, and marketing teams

-Organize tasks, updates, and deadlines inside ClickUp

-Prepare clear weekly performance and creator reports



You are not expected to create every TikTok video yourself.



You are expected to help make sure TikTok activity is:

-Organized

-Creative-led

-Performance-focused

-On-brand

-Properly tracked

-Moving forward



This Role Is for Someone Who

-Has hands-on experience with TikTok Ads Manager

-Understands ecommerce performance marketing

-Can review campaign data and explain what it means

-Understands that TikTok performance depends heavily on creative

-Can identify strong hooks, angles, creators, and video formats

-Is comfortable contacting creators they have never met

-Can write outreach that sounds natural instead of automated

-Understands Spark Ads and creator permissions

-Can manage multiple campaigns, creators, and deadlines

-Follows up consistently

-Communicates problems before they become larger issues

-Can follow brand and creative direction without ego

-Keeps ClickUp and reporting systems updated



Experience that helps:

-TikTok Ads Manager

-TikTok Shop

-Spark Ads

-TikTok Pixel and event tracking

-Influencer outreach

-UGC coordination

-Affiliate recruitment

-Ecommerce marketing

-Creative testing

-Shopify

-ClickUp

-Google Sheets or reporting dashboards



You do not need to be a famous TikTok creator.

You do need:

-Strong marketing judgment

-Good communication instincts

-Analytical thinking

-Attention to detail

-Strong organizational habits

-The discipline to follow through



How You’ll Work With the Team

-Data Team provides reporting, performance insights, and audience direction. You use that information to make better campaign and creator decisions.

-Creative Team develops videos, graphics, and campaign concepts. You provide creative feedback, performance insights, and creator content.

-Ads Team supports TikTok Pixel, events, and attribution. You identify and communicate tracking concerns.

You are not managing TikTok in isolation.



You are part of a connected system built to help ecommerce brands test better creative, manage spend responsibly, and grow through paid media and creator partnerships.



Why You’ll Like Working Here

-Clear expectations and workflows

-Variety across multiple ecommerce brands

-Structured campaign and creator systems

-Opportunities to build real creator relationships

-Access to creative and data support

-Leadership that values judgment and accountability

-Long-term role with growth opportunities



We do not reward activity for the sake of activity.

We reward useful analysis, organized execution, and consistent follow-through.

Application Process



PLEASE DO NOT JUST REPLY TO THIS POST ON THE JOB BOARD.



To be considered, you must complete all the steps below.

The Google Form is your online interview.



Step 1: Take a Short Online IQ Test

We respect intelligence, and we think you probably do too.

Go to the Fast Learner Free IQ Test and complete it

Create a free account at the end

Save the results URL for Step 3

Applicants without a valid link will not be considered.



Step 2: Record a 2 to 3 Minute Loom Video, Camera On

Create a free account at Loom

Speak clearly in English

Tell us about:

Your TikTok advertising experience

Your influencer, creator, or UGC experience

How you review campaign and creative performance

How you manage campaigns, follow-ups, and deadlines

Why this role is a good fit

Save the Loom URL for Step 3.



Step 3: Complete the Online Interview

NO AI ALLOWED. WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU.

Open the application form

Enter your contact details

Paste your IQ test results link

Paste your Loom video link

Answer all questions honestly and thoughtfully

Your answers matter more than perfect formatting.



Step 4: Live Video Interview, Camera On

This is where we get to know how you think.

I personally review every candidate who completes the steps above and will reach out directly to those who feel like the right fit.



If this role speaks to you, good.

That means you may be the kind of person we’re looking for.



Bring your best.

We’ll bring the system.

A few things our current team would tell you about working here:



We pay on time, every time. No chasing invoices, no excuses.



Your holidays matter. We swap U.S. holidays for Philippine holidays so you're off when your family is celebrating, not working through Undas or Holy Week.



No micromanagement. We hire experienced people and trust them to do the work.



What You'll Own:



This isn't an execution-only role. You'll be the paid ads department:



- Build, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns for home service clients — Search, Local Services Ads (LSAs), and call-focused campaigns where one wasted keyword can burn $200/day



- Run Meta Ads campaigns for med spa clients — lead gen for Botox, fillers, hair restoration, and aesthetic treatments



- Set up and verify conversion tracking — GA4, Google Tag Manager, call tracking, form tracking. If tracking is broken, everything downstream is fiction, and you know it



- Manage budget pacing across accounts and reallocate spend to what's working

- Mine search terms reports and maintain aggressive negative keyword lists

- A/B test ad copy and landing pages, document what you learn, and apply it

- Report results clearly — our PM handles client communication, but your numbers and insights drive what we tell them

- Flag landing page problems — you'll work alongside our developer to fix conversion killers



What We Need From You:



- 5+ years of hands-on PPC experience managing Google Ads accounts for U.S. clients — agency or freelance

Proven results in lead generation (not e-commerce ROAS — we need someone who understands cost-per-lead, call quality, and local service areas)



- Experience running paid ads for medical businesses, particularly doctors, who are under intense scrutiny when running paid ads 



- Deep fluency with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, and Google Tag Manager



- Experience with Local Services Ads is a major plus — home services is half our business



- Excellent written English — your reporting and internal communication need to be clear



- Reliability. This is the non-negotiable. We need someone who consistently shows up, meets deadlines, communicates early when something's off, and treats client budgets with care. If you are too busy to commit 5-10 hours a week now and 40+ hours in the near future, this is the wrong job for you. 



What Disqualifies You:



- You've only run e-commerce or dropshipping campaigns

- You've only done PPC as one task among many in a general VA role

- Your experience is limited to boosting posts or running
 Ads for your own page

- You can't show real account-level work (structure, not just screenshots of good numbers)





How to Apply



Send us the following:



- Your PPC background in 3–5 sentences — niches you've worked in, monthly budgets you've managed, and how long you've done this

- One campaign you're proud of — what the goal was, what you did, and what happened. Specific numbers beat vague claims

- One campaign that failed — and what you learned from it. If everything you've ever run was a success, we won't believe you

- Your availability — hours per week and your working schedule preference



Important: Use the subject line "Budget Pacing" when you apply. Applications without it won't be read — it's how we know you actually read this far.



We'll review applications, shortlist candidates for a short video call, and give finalists a small paid trial task using a sandbox account. No free work, ever.



If you're the kind of ads person who checks search terms reports before your first coffee, we'd love to meet you.

title: **Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator**
description:
# Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator



**William Holder Realty Team**



## Position Overview



The William Holder Realty Team is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and proactive **Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator** to oversee agent lead performance, database activity, system adoption, and sales accountability.



This person will function as a virtual extension of the Team Leader and Sales Manager, helping ensure that leads are worked properly, agents are following required processes, databases remain organized, and opportunities are not being missed.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working inside multiple real estate technology platforms, analyzing agent performance, identifying gaps, and holding agents accountable through clear communication, follow-up, coaching, and lead reassignment when necessary.



This is not simply a data-entry position. The right person must be able to review performance, recognize patterns, make recommendations, and take action.



## Key Responsibilities



### CRM and Database Management



* Monitor Follow Up Boss and other lead platforms to ensure leads are being contacted and followed up with consistently.

* Identify leads and contacts that have not been touched within the required follow-up period.

* Review agent databases for missed opportunities, incomplete records, inaccurate stages, and overdue tasks.

* Identify sphere contacts that have not been contacted in more than 90 days.

* Move unworked or neglected leads into the appropriate team lead pond or “Hot Pond.”

* Reassign leads when agents are not meeting the team’s follow-up and performance expectations.

* Add detailed notes regarding agent activity, lead status, coaching recommendations, and reassignment decisions.

* Perform virtual lead follow-up when appropriate through calls, texts,
s, and CRM campaigns.

* Recommend specific follow-up strategies for agents based on the lead’s history, source, stage, and engagement.



### Agent Performance Monitoring



Conduct regular performance reviews using data from:



* Follow Up Boss

* Zillow

* Zillow Home Loans funnels

* Maverick

* Ylopo

* Fello

* Zillow Pro

* Rezen

* RedX

* Additional team systems and lead platforms



Review and report on:



* Number of leads assigned

* Lead response time

* Pickup rate

* Contact rate

* Appointment-set rate

* Appointment-met rate

* Preapproval rate

* Offer rate

* Conversion rate

* Lead source performance

* Agent production

* Commission splits

* Overall sales performance

* Database engagement

* Follow-up consistency

* Zillow Home Loans usage and funnel activity



Provide agents and leadership with actionable feedback based on the data.



### Zillow Lead Management



Manage and monitor the team’s Zillow Sales Manager lists.



Review agents who:



* Have more than 50 active Zillow leads.

* Are ranked Fair or Low.

* Have a pickup rate below 25%.

* Have fewer than 20% of met clients preapproved.

* Have an appointment-met rate below 55%.

* Are not consistently updating lead statuses.

* Are failing to follow the required Zillow lead process.



Responsibilities include:



* Pausing agents from receiving new opportunities when appropriate.

* Nudging agents regarding overdue follow-up.

* Reassigning neglected or unworked leads.

* Reviewing Zillow ZIP-code coverage and agent availability.

* Monitoring Zillow lead routing and distribution.

* Reviewing agent Zillow profiles for completeness and quality.

* Ensuring agents maintain updated photos, biographies, reviews, transactions, and service areas.

* Encouraging and tracking proper usage of Zillow Pro.

* Reviewing the “My Agent Opportunities” smart list.

* Monitoring Zillow Home Loans activity and preapproval funnels.

* Communicating performance concerns and required corrective actions.



### Fello Database Management



* Review Fello for missed opportunities and homeowner engagement.

* Monitor new Fello features and recommend ways the team can use them.

* Identify marketing and retargeting opportunities.

* Confirm whether Fello is properly enriching the team database.

* Review seller intent, property activity, home valuation engagement, and potential listing opportunities.

* Share relevant opportunities and updates with agents and leadership.

* Help agents develop follow-up strategies for Fello-generated opportunities.

* Track whether agents are working the opportunities provided through the platform.



### New Agent Systems Review



Ensure every agent who has been with WHRT for fewer than three months is properly onboarded and actively using all required systems.



Systems may include:



* Follow Up Boss

* Rezen

* Ylopo

* Zillow

* Zillow Pro

* Zillow Home Loans

* Maverick

* Fello

* RedX

* Open to Close

* BrokerBlocks

* Client Giant

* Team communication and training platforms



Confirm that new agents:



* Have active logins.

* Understand how each system is used.

* Have completed their profiles.

* Are receiving the correct leads.

* Are following required workflows.

* Are updating lead stages and notes.

* Are completing assigned tasks.

* Understand team lead-conversion standards.

* Know where to find training materials and support.



Escalate access issues, training gaps, and performance concerns to leadership.



### Systems and Process Accountability



* Regularly audit agents’ use of team technology and systems.

* Ensure agents are following established lead-management and sales processes.

* Review Rezen for transactions, downline activity, stock awards, and relevant agent information.

* Confirm that agent profiles and records are accurate across all platforms.

* Identify systems that are being underutilized.

* Provide agents with reminders, resources, and feedback.

* Recommend improvements to team processes and technology usage.

* Help document and update standard operating procedures.

* Track recurring problems and present solutions to leadership.

* Assist with testing and implementing new features or workflows.



### Agent Communication and Accountability



* Contact agents regarding overdue leads, untouched contacts, missing notes, and incomplete tasks.

* Provide clear, professional, and constructive feedback.

* Help agents understand where their performance is falling short.

* Recommend specific actions to improve conversion.

* Follow up to confirm that required actions were completed.

* Recognize strong performance and share positive trends with leadership.

* Maintain consistent communication with agents without allowing accountability items to disappear into the CRM abyss.

* Escalate repeated noncompliance or performance issues to the Team Leader or Sales Manager.



### Reporting



Prepare regular reports for leadership covering:



* Leads requiring reassignment

* Agents requiring coaching

* Agents who should be paused

* Untouched database contacts

* Sphere contacts overdue for follow-up

* New-agent system adoption

* Zillow performance

* Zillow Home Loans performance

* Fello opportunities

* Lead-source conversion

* Follow-up gaps

* Appointment and preapproval metrics

* Overall agent performance

* Recommended corrective actions



Reports should clearly explain what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.



## Performance Expectations



The Virtual CRM & Lead Management Coordinator will be expected to:



* Reduce the number of unworked and neglected leads.

* Improve agent follow-up consistency.

* Increase CRM accuracy and database engagement.

* Improve pickup, contact, appointment, preapproval, and conversion rates.

* Ensure new agents are fully onboarded into all required systems.

* Identify missed opportunities before they are lost.

* Improve team utilization of Zillow Pro, Fello, Follow Up Boss, Maverick, Ylopo, and other platforms.

* Maintain organized documentation and detailed notes.

* Hold agents accountable in a professional and consistent manner.

* Make recommendations based on data rather than assumptions.



## Qualifications



* Experience working virtually with a real estate team, brokerage, inside sales department, or sales organization is strongly preferred.

* Experience with Follow Up Boss is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with Zillow, Zillow Pro, Ylopo, Fello, Maverick, Rezen, RedX, or similar platforms is a major advantage.

* Strong understanding of CRM management and lead-conversion processes.

* Comfortable reviewing data and identifying performance trends.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to communicate corrective feedback professionally.

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Able to manage multiple systems and priorities.

* Comfortable holding salespeople accountable.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently.

* Able to protect confidential client, agent, and company information.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who naturally notices when something is being missed and takes action before being asked.



They are organized, persistent, comfortable with technology, and able to balance accountability with professionalism. They do not simply report problems—they investigate them, document them, recommend a solution, and follow through.



This person should enjoy working with data, improving systems, helping agents perform at a higher level, and making sure every lead receives the attention it deserves.

title: Executive Assistant to a Founder — Multiple Ventures (Chief-of-Staff Track)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm a founder based in Manila running multiple ventures and projects. The flagship right now is Tadhana, the Philippines' invitation-only matchmaking platform ("Make your own destiny": human matchmakers, not algorithms), which is weeks from soft launch. Beyond that there are other businesses, products, and opportunities at different stages, and more will come. You would be my right hand across all of it.



THIS IS NOT A VA ROLE



I'm looking for a thinking partner: someone who takes a goal, breaks it down, makes sensible decisions without waiting for permission, and tells me when I'm wrong. You won't be tied to one company. You'll context-switch across projects, know more about parts of the portfolio than I do within three months, and help me d
 where our time goes. As the ventures grow, so does this role: performance bonuses are possible, and you'd be the first person I build a team around.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Business operations: drive each project's checklist, including registrations, launches, legal coordination, vendor management, and deadlines. Track everything across ventures and let nothing slip.

- Hiring and people: source and screen hires for whichever project needs them (for Tadhana: matchmakers and applicant-experience staff), schedule and sit in on interviews, run onboarding.

- Marketing and communications: social media presence, content calendars, and warm, on-brand communication with customers and applicants across projects.

- Founder support: calendar, inbox triage, travel, purchases, and the personal admin that keeps me focused on what matters.



YOU'RE PROBABLY A FIT IF YOU HAVE



- 3+ years as an EA, chief of staff, operations lead, or team lead (corporate, BPO leadership, or startup)

- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll draft messages that go out under my name and my companies' names.

- Receipts: you can tell me about decisions you made independently and projects you ran end-to-end

- Comfort juggling unrelated projects in the same week without dropping threads

- High discretion. You'll see business and personal matters that stay private, and you'll sign a strict confidentiality agreement.

- Comfort with Google Workspace, Notion/Sheets, Canva. Bonus for social-media or recruiting experience.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully; applications that skip any step are deleted unread)



1. Start your application with the single word DESTINY on its own line.

2. In 150 words or less: describe a decision you made at work without your boss's input, and what happened.

title: Healthcare SEO Strategist  (Mid-Level to Senior)
description:
Healthcare SEO Strategist (Mid-Level to Senior)



Direct Medical or Healthcare SEO Experience Required



Work arrangement: Long-term remote contractor Starting workload: Approximately 10–40 hours per month starting



Starting compensation: $8.14–$12.21 per hour w/ potential immediate increase (keep reading below for details)

Location: Philippines Schedule: Flexible, with negotiable Pacific Time overlap



About the Opportunity

This is not an entry-level SEO position.



MedGains is a U.S.-based, clinician-founded healthcare marketing agency. We help patient-facing and B2B healthcare organizations strengthen visibility, authority, and growth through SEO, content, local search, and emerging AI-driven discovery.



Direct, verifiable experience developing and managing SEO campaigns for healthcare, medical, health-technology, or clinically focused organizations is required.



The selected strategist will begin with responsibility for one active U.S. healthcare SEO campaign. As strong performance is demonstrated and MedGains adds new clients, additional healthcare campaigns and approved working hours may be assigned.



Our intention is to develop a long-term relationship with someone who can gradually become a central part of MedGains’ healthcare search operations.



About MedGains

Healthcare marketing should begin with understanding healthcare.



MedGains was founded by a licensed Respiratory Therapist with experience across hospitals, critical care, pediatric and adult settings, sleep medicine, and home healthcare.



While continuing his clinical career, he also invested in healthcare startups, supported their business-development efforts, and helped market their technologies to difficult-to-reach prospects including hospitals, medical practices, healthcare executives, and other key decision-makers.



That combination of clinical experience, healthcare operations, entrepreneurship, business development, and marketing strategy shapes how MedGains approaches every campaign.



We do not begin by asking only:



“What keywords should this organization rank for?”



We ask:



How does this healthcare organization actually grow?

Who is searching—patients, clinicians, administrators, referral partners, or business buyers?

What information do they need before making a decision?

What have competitors and current search results overlooked?

How can the organization become a trusted authority rather than simply another search result?



Our principle is simple:



Understanding first. Marketing second.

What You Will Own

You will help lead the strategic direction, execution planning, quality, and performance of healthcare SEO campaigns.



Your responsibilities may include:



Researching healthcare markets, services, audiences, competitors, and search behavior

Developing keyword, topic, search-intent, content, and site-architecture strategies

Building prioritized SEO roadmaps and monthly action plans

Recommending service pages, location pages, content clusters, and supporting resources

Reviewing existing pages and identifying content gaps

Creating or directing SEO content briefs and outlines

Improving on-page SEO, internal linking, metadata, and topical authority

Identifying technical issues involving crawling, indexing, site structure, duplicate content, performance, canonicals, schema, and internal links

Guiding local SEO, Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, directories, and location visibility

Identifying healthcare associations, directories, publications, partnerships, and authority-building opportunities

Monitoring Google AI experiences, answer engines, generative search, entity signals, brand mentions, and structured information

Tracking rankings, organic visibility, traffic, leads, and other meaningful outcomes

Investigating performance changes and adjusting the strategy based on evidence

Clearly communicating priorities, findings, and recommendations



Depending on campaign needs, implementation may involve writers, developers, technical SEO specialists, outreach resources, or other contributors.



You must understand how the complete SEO action plan fits together, what resources are needed, how contributors should be directed, and whether the completed work meets the required standard.

Required Healthcare SEO Experience

Applicants without direct healthcare or medical SEO experience will not be considered.



Your experience should include work with one or more healthcare business models, such as:



Physician practices or specialty clinics

Dental or dental-specialty organizations

Home health, home care, hospice, or senior care

Physical therapy, rehabilitation, chiropractic, or wellness

Sleep medicine

Medical transportation

Medical devices or diagnostics

Healthcare SaaS

Digital health or health technology

Healthcare e-commerce or clinically focused products



You do not need experience in every category.



We strongly value candidates who understand both:



Patient-facing healthcare SEO

B2B healthcare SEO for products, devices, diagnostics, software, or health technology



Experience serving U.S. healthcare clients is strongly preferred.



Exceptional candidates who have successfully managed healthcare SEO campaigns within other countries will also be considered when they can demonstrate measurable outcomes, strong strategic thinking, and the ability to learn the U.S. healthcare market.

What You Must Bring

Proven experience developing healthcare SEO strategies

Healthcare case studies, websites, or portfolio examples

Strong technical SEO knowledge

Strong content and topical-authority strategy experience

Experience with local SEO and authority building

Experience coordinating or managing a complete SEO action plan

Strong knowledge of Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4, or comparable tools

Understanding of healthcare trust, clinical accuracy, and content sensitivities

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong communication and independent judgment

The ability to explain why a strategy is being recommended

A willingness to question assumptions and contribute ideas rather than simply follow instructions

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You will likely thrive at MedGains if you:



Ask thoughtful questions before recommending tactics

Enjoy researching complex healthcare markets

Care about business outcomes rather than completed task counts

Identify problems and opportunities proactively

Investigate unfamiliar healthcare subjects instead of making assumptions

Can respectfully challenge an idea when you see a stronger direction

Welcome direct and thoughtful feedback

Want to deepen your expertise in traditional SEO and AI-driven search

Want your thinking to influence how a growing healthcare agency develops its standards



This role is not suitable for someone who relies on generic templates, surface-level research, automated content without meaningful review, or the same SEO formula for every healthcare client.

Hours and Compensation

The position will begin on an hourly contractor basis with responsibility for one active healthcare SEO campaign.



The starting workload is expected to be approximately 10–30 approved hours per month depending on first wave of SEO campaigns.



A note on hours: the first month of a new campaign is setup-heavy such as the audit, Google Business Profile work, core service and location pages, and initial research. So hours will run toward the top of that range early on. Once the foundational work is complete, monthly hours on a single campaign may settle somewhat before growing again as additional clients are assigned.



Actual weekly hours may vary depending on campaign priorities, deadlines, meetings, and how the strategist organizes and performs the work.



Starting compensation is $8.14–$12.21 per hour, based on:



Direct healthcare SEO experience

Strategic capabilities

Demonstrated campaign results

Communication skills

Technical knowledge

Level of responsibility

Work personally performed



Exceptional candidates with extensive healthcare SEO leadership, U.S. healthcare campaign experience, or proven medical-device and healthcare SaaS results may be considered above the posted range. 



The initial campaign will have a maximum allowance of 40 approved hours per month. Any hours beyond that limit must be discussed and approved by MedGains in advance.

Schedule and Availability

Some availability during Pacific Time is preferred for communication, collaboration, and occasional meetings.



However, the schedule is not intended to be a strict daily shift.



MedGains is willing to discuss and negotiate a reasonable overnight or early-morning schedule with the selected candidate during the interview process.



The exact availability window may vary depending on:



The candidate’s existing schedule

Campaign requirements

Client meetings

Deadlines

Communication needs

The number of assigned campaigns



Much of the strategist’s work may be completed independently, provided communication remains dependable and agreed deadlines are met.

Growth Opportunity

The selected strategist will initially manage one healthcare SEO campaign.



As they demonstrate:



Strong strategic judgment

Dependable communication

Quality execution

Efficient use of approved hours

Clear reporting

Measurable campaign progress

The ability to coordinate supporting contributors



Additional MedGains healthcare SEO clients may be assigned.



This will allow the strategist’s approved hours, monthly earnings, responsibilities, and influence within MedGains to grow.



Once the strategist is successfully managing approximately three steady SEO campaigns, the hourly contractor arrangement may transition into a fixed monthly contractor retainer.



The monthly compensation will be based on the number and complexity of assigned campaigns, demonstrated performance, and level of strategic ownership.

How to Apply

Please include all of the following in your application:



A brief explanation of your direct healthcare or medical SEO experience

The healthcare sectors you have worked in

One healthcare SEO campaign you are most proud of

The strategy you developed for that campaign

The measurable results achieved

Links to relevant websites, case studies, reports, or portfolio examples

Your experience with medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare SaaS, digital health, or other B2B healthcare companies

The SEO tools you regularly use

Your requested hourly rate within the posted range

Your approximate monthly availability

Your preferred working hours and ability to provide some Pacific Time overlap



Begin the subject line of your application with:



HEALTHCARE SEARCH STRATEGIST



Applications without direct healthcare SEO examples or evidence will not be considered.



We are not looking for someone to quietly complete assignments.



We are looking for a serious healthcare SEO strategist who wants to contribute ideas, strengthen campaigns, grow with the agency, and help shape the future of healthcare search at MedGains.

title: Quality Control Admin — Real Estate Media
description:
About Us



We are a Canadian real estate media company that produces high-end photography, video, drone footage, and floor plans for real estate agents and brokerages. Our work is fast-paced, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven — agents need their listings live quickly, and the quality of every deliverable reflects directly on our reputation.



We're a small, growing team and we take pride in producing work that stands out. We're now looking for a detail-focused admin to own our quality control process and make sure every photo gallery and floor plan that goes out the door meets our standard before it reaches the client.





The Role



You will be the last set of eyes on every deliverable before it's sent to the client. Your job is to review completed photo galleries and floor plans, flag anything that doesn't meet our quality standard, and approve deliverables for delivery — all inside our project management and delivery platforms.



This is not a creative editing role. It's a precision review role. You need a sharp eye, strong attention to detail, and the ability to follow a checklist consistently.





What You'll Do



Photo QC



Review completed real estate photo galleries in Aryeo (our delivery platform)

Check for issues including: incorrect exposure or color, visible objects that should have been removed (cords, clutter), blurry or out-of-focus images, missed shots from the required shot list, incorrect order/sequencing of photos

Log any issues clearly so the editor knows exactly what to fix and where

Approve galleries that meet standard and flag those that need revision





Floor Plan QC



Review iGuide floor plans for accuracy and presentation

Check that room labels are correct and consistently named

Check that the layout is clean, legible, and matches the property

Flag any errors or inconsistencies before delivery



Admin & Tracking



Update task statuses in ClickUp as jobs move through QC

Keep a simple log of common revision types to help identify recurring issues

Communicate revision requests to the editor clearly and professionally

Confirm re-submissions meet the standard before approving



Tools We Use





Aryeo — our delivery and gallery platform (you will review and approve/reject galleries here)

ClickUp — task and project management (you will update job statuses here)

Dropbox — file access for floor plans





We will train you on all of these tools. You do not need prior experience with them, but you do need to be comfortable learning software quickly.





What We're Looking For



Strong attention to detail — this is the most important quality for this role

Good eye for image quality (exposure, sharpness, color balance) — prior experience with real estate photo review or photo editing is a strong asset but not required

Clear, professional written English for logging revision notes

Reliable, consistent, and self-managed — you'll be working async and we need someone who follows through without being chased

Comfortable following SOPs and checklists

Stable internet connection and a dedicated workspace



Hours & Compensation



Hours: Approximately 10–20 hours per week to start, with the potential to grow as our volume increases

Schedule: Flexible, but turnaround on QC reviews must happen within a set window (usually same business day)

Pay: Competitive for this type of role — we will discuss rate based on your experience





How to Apply



Please send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the following:





A short introduction — who you are, what you've done, and why this role interests you

Any experience you have with photo review, quality control, admin work, or real estate media

To show us you read this posting carefully, start your application with the word "Aryeo" at the top.





Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We are looking for someone who pays attention to detail — and that starts here.





We're excited to find the right person and build something great together.

Configure domain and subdomain DNS records (A, CNAME, TXT, MX) to connect our existing website to GHL.



Set up proper

Manage our complete A2P 10DLC Standard Brand and Campaign registration. You must ensure our legal business name matches our EIN/147c letter perfectly to guarantee approval.



2. Website Integration

3. Workflow Automation & CRM Configuration



Build a customized CRM pipeline that reflects our actual sales process.



Create an automated "Speed to Lead" workflow that triggers instantly when a website form is submitted (e.g., Tag applied -> Pipeline stage updated -> Internal notification -> Immediate SMS/Email to the lead).



Troubleshoot and test all triggers to ensure there are no silent failures before launch.



Requirements

You must have proven, hands-on experience specifically with the technical backend of GoHighLevel (not just front-end page building).



You must have successfully navigated the A2P 10DLC registration process in 2025/2026 and understand the strict carrier requirements for opt-in compliance.



Fluent in managing DNS records across providers (e.g., Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap).



Strong English communication skills to document what you built and hand it over clearly.

- Continuously test and optimise creatives, messaging, landing pages, advertisements, and marketing funnels to improve CTR, engagement, conversions, and ROAS.

- Source, identify, and build relationships with micro-influencers, content creators, affiliates, ambassadors, and KOLs across TikTok, Instagram,

- Stay up to date with the latest e-commerce trends, marketplace updates, platform algorithms, AI tools, and digital marketing best practices.

- Proven experience managing TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Shopify, and Meta 
 & Instagram).

- Strong understanding of marketplace operations, e-commerce marketing, and digital advertising.

- Experience in product listing optimisation, campaign management, and conversion rate optimisation (CRO).

- Strong knowledge of social media trends, content strategy, influencer marketing, and viral content creation.

- Experience working with micro-influencers, affiliates, ambassadors, or KOL campaigns is highly preferred.

- A proactive, self-driven, and creative mindset with the ability to take initiative, solve problems independently, and consistently generate fresh marketing ideas that drive business growth.

- Excellent analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.

- Able to work independently, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.

- Detail-oriented with a proactive mindset and a passion for continuous improvement.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, or similar marketing tools is an advantage.

- Experience with Amazon Seller Central is a bonus but not required.

- Experience working across multiple Southeast Asian markets is an advantage.



What We're Looking For

- You should be passionate about e-commerce, enjoy analysing data, testing new ideas, creating engaging marketing campaigns, collaborating with creative teams, and producing content that drives real business results.

- You'll play a key role in growing our brands across Singapore and Malaysia, while helping shape our expansion into the wider Southeast Asian and global market. We're looking for someone who is entrepreneurial, proactive, and always searching for the next opportunity to increase traffic, conversions, and revenue.



If you're driven by results, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to make a direct impact on building brands across Southeast Asia, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Google Media Buyer
description:

JOB TITLE: Google Media Buyer





This is a full-time role for a Google Media Buyer. You’ll be responsible for the execution, optimization, and scaling of paid campaigns across Google Ads surfaces (Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen). You’ll work closely with Strategists and Creators to deploy UGC-driven campaigns, manage budgets, and leverage AI-powered buying strategies.

Campaign Setup & Execution

Take full ownership of the Google Ads account

Launch, manage, and scale campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMAX, YouTube, Demand Gen).

Maintain campaign guardrails: brand vs. non-brand search, PMax asset groups, YouTube whitelisting, and Demand Gen deployment.

Creative Deployment & Rights Management

Source, upload, and organize rights-cleared creator content (UGC, founder videos, brand assets).

Manage creator whitelisting (channel linking or URL permissions).

Deploy assets in required formats: images (1.91:1, 1:1, 4:5), vertical & long-form video, ad copy (headlines + descriptions).





Optimization & Testing

Run bi-weekly low-cost testing loops: add new assets, launch fresh asset groups, and iterate.

Apply thresholds: pause underperformers, scale winners, refresh every 30–45 days.

Monitor PMAX ad strength, feed health, and attribution accuracy.





Budget & Measurement

Ensure proper pacing of media spend while maximizing ROAS and CPA efficiency.

Apply consistent UTM frameworks for cross-channel measurement.

Use server-side integrations (Upstackified) to sync Shopify/Klaviyo/CRM data.





Data, Feeds & Signals

Maintain Merchant Center feeds (via Symprosys) and resolve disapprovals.

Set up custom segments (keywords, URLs, apps) and leverage creator-driven audiences.

Build lifecycle audiences (purchasers, cart abandoners, product viewers) for retargeting.





Collaboration & Reporting

Complete and submit weekly performance reports

Partner with Strategists and Designers to align creative and strategy.

Provide performance insights: wins, trends, and scaling opportunities.

Ensure compliance with Google Ads policies and rights agreements.





Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on experience running Google Ads campaigns in an agency or eCommerce setting.

Proven success managing PMAX, YouTube Ads, and Search campaigns for acquisition and retention.

Strong understanding of UGC-driven creative strategy and rights management.

Experience with Shopify integrations, product feed management, and data syncs.

Familiarity with attribution, UTMs, and cross-channel measurement.

Detail-oriented with strong executional discipline and ability to troubleshoot fast.

Clear communicator, able to work with Strategists, Creators, and Designers to drive performance.





Bonus:

Experience with Refunnel, Social Snowball, Upstackified, Symprosys.

Comfort running true YouTube whitelisting campaigns with creators.

Familiarity with Klaviyo, Triple Whale, or other attribution tools.
