title: Executive Assistant to Founder - Shopify Ecommerce Fashion Brand
description:
Executive Assistant to Founder



International Ecommerce Men's Fashion Brand  |  Full Time  |  Long Term  |  Remote



We are hiring a highly organised, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to work directly with the founder of a fast-growing men's fashion brand selling internationally on Shopify.



This is a high-impact role for someone who loves building systems, documenting processes, and taking ownership of tasks so they never come back to the founder again.



We are a family owned and operated business with strong ethical and family values. We treat our team with compassion and care, and we're committed to nurturing the right candidate: helping you grow your skills, develop your leadership ability, and become the best version of yourself. We also offer flexibility for family care, because we understand family comes first. If you need to work around school runs, appointments, or caring for loved ones, we'll make the schedule work with you, as long as the work gets done to a high standard. 



This is NOT a basic VA or customer support role. It is about supporting the CEO directly and improving business organisation and systems.



We are looking for someone who can think critically, spot problems before they happen, and turn messy recurring tasks into clean, documented systems.



Your main goal is simple: take repeat tasks off the founder's plate permanently, by doing them well and building the SOP so they run without him.



Responsibilities

• Manage the founder's inbox: triage, draft replies, follow up so nothing is missed

• Communicate with business contacts such as warehouse teams, suppliers and billing.

• Monitor and moderate social media channels and delegate with customer support team

• Upload and maintain products in Shopify (titles, descriptions, collections, tags, metafields, images)

• Keep supplier communications on track: follow-ups, order confirmations, shipping updates

• Create and maintain SOPs for every recurring task (Loom videos plus written docs)

• Systemise workflows using Google Suite, Slack, and AI tools

• Use AI (Join our Claude Team Plan) daily to draft, summarise, research, and speed up work

• Audit your own work: catch errors before the founder ever sees them

• Escalate to the founder only when genuinely necessary



Essential skills (do not apply without these)

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Shopify admin experience (product editing, creation, collections, basic settings)

•
 management for a busy executive

• Experience creating SOPs and documenting processes

• Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack

• Comfortable using AI tools like Claude in daily work

• Extreme attention to detail

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision



Bonus if you have experience with

• Ecommerce or DTC fashion brands

• SEO Optimisation

• Meta Ads, or Google Ads

• Canva, Graphic Design or Video Editing or basic content creation

• Social Media interest and knowledge 

• Working directly with a founder or CEO



An interest in fashion, design, social media, copywriting, and marketing would be beneficial. This role grows in those directions.

What winning looks like in this role

• Within 90 days, the founder no longer touches Shopify admin or routine

• Every recurring task has an SOP you created and own

• Systems keep improving month after month without being asked

• Booking in 40 hrs and ticking the boxes with no improvements made

• You grow with the business: over time you will learn marketing, product creation, and advanced AI skills directly from the founder, with real career progression as the team grows



We are growing fast, and building a long-term team. We pay reliably, respect your time, and promote from within.



IMPORTANT: To apply, answer these 5 questions

1. Describe your Shopify experience in detail. What exactly have you done in the Shopify admin?

2. Tell me about an executive or founder you have supported. What did you take off their plate?

3. Describe an SOP or system you created. What problem did it solve?

4. How do you currently use AI tools like Claude in your work? Give a real example.

5. The founder is travelling with limited access. His inbox has 300 unread
s. Buried in them you find: three urgent supplier issues, one overdue bill, and one customer who says their order never arrived. The customer is threatening a chargeback and a negative Trustpilot review, and has already commented on our social media calling us a scam. We have a dedicated customer support team. In what order do you handle these, and why? Walk me through exactly what you would do, including who you would involve, and write the exact message you would send when handing the customer issue over to the support team.



Final instruction

Start your application with the phrase: “Systems set you free”

Second final instruction: One line in this ad does not belong and goes against everything this role stands for. At the end of your application, tell us which line it is and, in one or two sentences, why it's wrong.



Applications that do not follow instructions will be ignored.

description:
About Masqué



Masqué is a private membership community that produces premium social events and experiences throughout the United States.



We're a growing company with ambitious goals, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



This isn't a traditional customer service job or a typical virtual assistant position. You'll become a key member of a small, high-performing team where your work will directly influence our members' experience and help shape how the company operates.



We're looking for someone who is organized, proactive, dependable, and genuinely enjoys solving problems.



---



## The Role



Your first responsibility is ensuring every member has an outstanding experience.



If someone can't access the member portal, has a ticketing question, or encounters a problem, you'll take ownership until it's resolved. You'll communicate by
, text, and occasionally by phone or Zoom.



When member support is quiet, you'll work alongside the founder on operations, marketing, organization, research, and special projects.



No two days are exactly alike.



---



## Schedule



* Full-time

* Approximately **11:00 AM – 8:00 PM US Eastern Time**

* Must be comfortable working US business hours.

* Additional availability is required during event weeks and on event days, when member activity is highest.



---

* Respond quickly and professionally to member questions.

* Help members complete verification and access their accounts.

* Troubleshoot technical issues.

* Schedule Zoom or phone calls when needed.

* Follow up until every issue is completely resolved.

* Coordinate with our developers when technical fixes are required.

* Ensure members always know what's happening and what comes next.



### Operations



* Assist with project coordination.

* Keep tasks and projects organized.

* Follow up with vendors and contractors.

* Conduct online research.

* Maintain internal documentation.

* Help improve our systems and processes.



### Marketing & Communications



* Build and schedule
 campaigns.

* Assist with SMS campaigns.

* Proofread communications.

* Update website content.

* Help manage CRM and member communications.



### Administrative Support



* Calendar coordination.

* Document preparation.

* Data entry.

* Photo organization.

* General administrative tasks.

* Other projects as needed.



---



## What We're Looking For



You should have:



* Excellent written English.

* Clear spoken English.

* Strong communication skills.

* Excellent organizational ability.

* Attention to detail.

* Good judgment.

* A calm, professional demeanor.

* The ability to learn new software quickly.

Experience with Airtable, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, Memberstack, CRM software, or event operations is a plus, but not required.



---



## The Kind of Person Who Will Succeed Here

* Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

* Like solving problems.

* Communicate clearly.

* Keep commitments.

* Learn quickly.

* Stay organized under pressure.

* Finish what you start.

* Look for ways to improve how things work.



---

---

description:
Hey everyone! 



We are looking to partner with a talented video editor to help us create high-converting
 video ads.



Right now, we are looking to get 2 solar videos created immediately. 

We already have the complete scripts, visual cues, and graphic concepts locked in—we just need a creative editor to bring them to life by sourcing the right footage, pacing it to a great beat, and making it look fantastic.



What We Are Looking For (The Style):



Real & Authentic: We want to steer clear of overly polished, bright corporate stock footage or smiling actors. We want this to look authentic, featuring clips of real, hardworking people on actual, messy job sites—sweating, drilling, running conduit, and putting in the work.



Color Direction: We want to stand out from typical solar ads, so please no bright green and no yellow graphics or text. We are aiming for a premium, high-contrast, moody aesthetic (think dark grays, deep blues, and crisp white).



Energy: Fast, cinematic cuts driven by a heavy, rhythmic blues-rock or hard rock drum beat.



Text: Clear, kinetic text overlays that match the voiceover so the ad makes total sense even when watched on mute.



Ongoing Opportunity:

This isn't a one-off project! We are looking for a reliable, go-to editor who we can work with long-term. If we work well together on these first two ads, we have a steady stream of ongoing video creation and variation work lined up for the future.



How to Apply:

Please drop a link to your portfolio or share some of your previous work. 

Please also send through your all-inclusive price for completing these first 2 videos. 



Looking forward to working together!

We are a social media content company that creates short-form video content for health and wellness brands. Our content mix includes talking head videos, motion clips, voiceovers, and AI-generated visuals, all combined into finished short-form videos for social media.



We are looking for editors who want to be trained up into full AI content creators. If you can edit and you learn fast, we will teach you the rest.



This is a long-term position, not a one-time project.



What you will be doing:

- Creating talking head videos (HeyGen)

- Editing short-form videos into polished finished content (CapCut or your preferred editing software)

- Using AI tools to generate realistic images of characters (Nano Banana Pro)

- Generating natural sounding voiceovers (ElevenLabs)

- Generating motion video clips (Google Veo)

- Using Claude AI to write prompts and improve your work quality



You do not need prior experience with these specific AI tools. We have a full step by step onboarding program that trains you on everything. But you do need to be someone who learns fast and pays close attention to detail.



What we are looking for:

- Reliable and consistent. You show up every day and communicate if something comes up. This is the number one thing we care about.

- Detail-oriented. The difference between a good video and a bad one comes down to small details.

- Coachable. You take feedback seriously and apply it to your next video.

- Has their own laptop or desktop computer with a stable internet connection.

- Has their own video editing software (CapCut works great).

- Can follow instructions carefully without needing to be told the same thing twice.



Schedule:

Monday through Saturday. Daily check-in at 9:00 AM PHT. All work for the day must be completed and submitted by 9:00 PM PHT.



Pay:

$3 per completed video. The more you produce, the more you make.



The first week is a trial and onboarding period. You will go through our program that trains you on every tool step by step and gets you up to speed. We move through it quickly so you are producing at a high level fast, so we are looking for people who can put focused time in during that first week. Once you are through it and producing quality work, you are fully on the team.



To apply:

Do not just send me a message saying you are interested. To be considered for this position you must complete the following test assignment and include it in your application (we will pay for this):




/document/d/1CThcRdyZBbELEDKxItxLL49ZHlCM-uCqbxUgLofWY9M/edit?usp=sharing

title: Patient Concierge & Lead Conversion Specialist – Longevity Clinic
description:
We are hiring a warm, polished, and persuasive Patient Concierge & Lead Conversion Specialist to respond to prospective patients and book qualified consultations at our in-person medical clinics in Beverly Hills, California, and North Georgia.



This is a patient-facing sales and appointment-setting position—not a general administrative VA role. You will often be the first person a prospective patient speaks with, so you must be responsive, professional, confident, and excellent at building trust over the phone.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



- Respond to new leads within five minutes during assigned working hours

- Contact leads by phone, text, and
 using GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Learn each prospect’s goals and determine whether our services may be a good fit

- Explain our practice and services using approved information

- Qualify prospects based on our provided criteria, including their interest in self-pay care

- Address common questions and objections without providing medical advice

- Book qualified prospects for in-person consultations

- Follow up consistently with leads who are not ready to schedule immediately

- Keep accurate notes, tasks, and lead statuses in GHL

- Work closely with the head of the medical practice and the head of AdDisruption, our marketing agency



ABOUT OUR PRACTICES:



We provide proactive, preventive medical care for patients who want to improve both their healthspan and lifespan. We do not accept insurance.



You will be trained on our services, qualification criteria, patient profiles, and approved messaging. Topics may include testosterone treatment for men and women, platelet-rich plasma treatments, peptides, preventive medicine, anti-aging medicine, and longevity.



You do not need to be a medical expert. However, you must be curious, eager to learn, and comfortable discussing medical and longevity topics accurately. Familiarity with respected experts, podcasts, or trends in the longevity space is a plus.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:



- Has exceptional spoken and written English

- Speaks clearly and is easily understood by American patients

- Has a warm, polished phone presence appropriate for a premium medical practice

- Sounds conversational rather than scripted

- Has experience in phone sales, appointment setting, lead conversion, or patient coordination

- Is comfortable discussing pricing and qualifying prospects for self-pay services

- Can persuade and overcome objections without being aggressive

- Is dependable, organized, coachable, and consistent with follow-up

- Has experience with GHL or a similar CRM

- Has experience in medical, longevity, wellness, aesthetics, or another high-trust service business



This is a remote position representing established in-person medical clinics. You may explain services using our approved materials, but you must never diagnose, recommend treatment, promise results, or provide medical advice.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief phone role-play to demonstrate spoken communication, listening, rapport-building, objection handling, and appointment-setting ability.

title: Credit Report & Dispute Specialist
description:
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–11:00 AM Central Time

Daily Check-In: 7:30 AM Central Time

Hours: 15 hours per week

Hourly Pay: $7 per hour

Paychecks are paid every 15th and 30th of each month



TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS AT THE END OF THIS APPLICATION



This position will begin at 15 hours per week. Our goal is to increase the specialist’s hours as the 850 Club Membership grows. Applicants should prepare to work more hours as more members join.



About the Position



850 Club Credit is hiring an experienced Credit Report & Dispute Specialist to manage client disputes, educate our members, and answer credit-report-related questions inside our online community.



This is not simply a letter-processing position. We need someone who can carefully review credit reports, identify potential reporting issues, prepare accurate disputes, track results, and explain the process in an easy-to-understand way.



Primary Responsibilities

Review three-bureau credit reports.

Identify potentially inaccurate, incomplete, duplicated, outdated, or unauthorized information.

Prepare customized dispute letters using company-approved procedures and AI tools.

Create separate dispute letters for Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.

Review all AI-generated letters for accuracy before submission.

Process monthly dispute rounds for assigned clients.

Compare updated reports with previous reports.

Track disputed accounts, submission dates, responses, results, and follow-up actions.

Update client records and dispute progress inside our systems.

Prepare CFPB complaint drafts when appropriate and approved by management.

Escalate complicated cases to management.

Conduct one live, one-hour dispute education training every week for DIY 850 Club members.

Answer dispute-related questions inside the 850 Club community.

Help members understand realistic timelines, possible outcomes, and next steps.

Send a daily or end-of-shift progress report.

Protect all client information and follow company privacy procedures.

Important Expectations



The specialist must:



Never guarantee deletions or credit-score increases.

Never dispute information simply because it is negative.

Only dispute information the client has identified or confirmed as potentially inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, duplicated, or unauthorized.

Never invent dispute reasons, facts, or supporting information.

Communicate professionally and avoid providing legal advice.

Complete work accurately and on time.

Be comfortable speaking and teaching during weekly virtual sessions.

Be available consistently during the required Central Time schedule.

Qualifications

Previous experience processing consumer credit disputes.

Strong knowledge of Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion credit reports.

Experience reviewing collections, charge-offs, late payments, inquiries, personal information, public records, and other derogatory accounts.

Familiarity with the Fair Credit Reporting Act, CFPB complaints, identity-theft disputes, and Metro 2 reporting is preferred.

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable conducting live virtual training.

Comfortable using ChatGPT or similar AI tools.

Experience with GoHighLevel, Skool, Trello, Lob, or credit-repair software is helpful but not required.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, webcam, microphone, and backup internet access.

Strong attention to detail and ability to protect confidential client information.



TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, REPLY WITH SUBJECT LINE "I AM YOUR DISPUTE SPECIALIST" & Answer the following questions:

1. Do you speak strong english? (this role requires recorded zoom calls of dispute education to our clients) 

Include your resume or portfolio. 

2. How many years of credit-repair or credit-dispute experience do you have?

3. What experience do you have creating CFPB complaints?

4. What do you understand about the FCRA and Metro 2 reporting?

5. How would you respond to a member who asks, “Can you guarantee this account will be deleted?”

description:
### Work Directly with a U.S. PM&R Physician | Long-Term Opportunity



## About the Practice



Jiang Mobile Medical is a growing U.S. Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R) practice providing care to patients in skilled nursing facilities.



We are building highly standardized, AI-assisted clinical workflows that allow physicians to spend more time caring for patients while maintaining exceptional documentation quality.

mbers.



This is **not** a traditional medical scribe position, and it is **not** a software engineering or AI developer role.

Training will be provided.



---

* Review discharge summaries

### Clinical Operations



* Organize patient records

### Administrative Support



* Maintain organized digital files

* Follow written Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Communicate professionally with the physician

* Complete assigned tasks accurately and on time

# Who We're Looking For



The ideal candidate enjoys creating order from complexity.



You are naturally organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.



You enjoy following structured processes while continuously improving them.



You take pride in producing accurate work and catching details that others might overlook.



You are comfortable learning new technology but do not need previous AI expertise.



---



# Preferred Qualifications



Healthcare experience is strongly preferred.



Examples include:



* Registered Nurse (RN)

* Physical Therapist (PT)

* Occupational Therapist (OT)

* Pharmacist

* Medical Technologist

* Medical Assistant

* Medical Scribe

* Healthcare Virtual Assistant



Experience with U.S. healthcare is preferred but not required.



---



# Skills That Matter Most



We care much more about reliability and attention to detail than advanced technical skills.



We're looking for someone with:



* Excellent written English

* Strong medical terminology

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Organization

* Critical thinking

* Professional communication

* Ability to follow standardized workflows

* Willingness to learn new software



Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools is a plus, but not required. We will train you to use our physician-developed AI documentation system.



---

Because this position involves confidential medical information, applicants must have:



* A private workspace where patient information cannot be viewed by others

* A reliable computer

* Stable high-speed internet

* Willingness to use secure passwords and multi-factor authentication

* Willingness to comply with HIPAA privacy and confidentiality requirements

* Willingness to sign confidentiality agreements before beginning work



As our practice grows, work may be performed through a secure virtual desktop environment.



---



# Schedule



Initially:



* Approximately 15–20 hours per week



As the practice grows:



* Opportunity for increased hours

* Expanded responsibilities

* Long-term career growth



---



# Why This Position Is Different



We're building long-term systems—not just completing tasks.



The physician develops the clinical workflows and AI documentation systems.



Your role is to operate those systems with accuracy, identify opportunities for improvement, and help build efficient clinical operations.



Outstanding tea
mbers will have opportunities to expand into broader clinical operations, workflow optimization, quality improvement, and other healthcare projects as our organization grows.



---

1. Application review

2. Video interview

3. Short paid skills assessment

4. Reference checks

5. Paid training period

6. Long-term position for the right candidate



---

title: Asset Dispatch Specialist (Direct Experience Only)
description:
AJG Transport is a performance driven, asset based transportation company operating a growing fleet anchored in dedicated freight. We are looking for an Asset Dispatch Specialist that will serve as the driver’s first point of contact and will play a critical role in keeping our trucks, drivers, and freight moving efficiently.



About the Role

You will act as the central link between drivers and the operations team. You will manage day-to-day driver needs while building and adjusting daily dispatch schedules to prevent trucks from sitting idle and loads from running late. When a driver encounters an issue, you are the person they contact. When schedules, equipment, freight requirements, or Hours of Service limitations change, you are responsible for coordinating the solution.



Success in this role requires consistent execution, urgency, accountability, and clear communication. Drivers must remain supported, schedules must stay organized, equipment must remain productive, and operational issues must be resolved before they escalate.



Why This Role Matters

This is not a call center dispatch seat. This is driver centric fleet operations. You are the face of the company to our drivers and the engine of our daily execution. If your communication is slow, equipment sits and drivers get frustrated. If you manage and schedule with discipline and urgency, drivers stay, trucks run, and freight moves on time.



What You’ll Be Doing



Driver Management (first point of contact)

• Be the primary daily contact for an assigned group of drivers, the person they trust and call first.

• Own driver issues day to day: schedule questions, equipment, routing, pay questions routed correctly, and general support.

• Build relationships that keep drivers satisfied, informed, and retained. A driver who feels managed and supported stays.



Driver Scheduling & Dispatch

• Build and manage the daily driver schedule across local, regional, and dedicated lane assignments.

• Assign loads and coordinate trucks with precision and urgency, the right driver on the right run and on time.

• Adjust the schedule in real time as freight, HOS, and equipment realities change.



Execution & Uptime

• Keep trucks moving, eliminate idle time, cover every scheduled run, and close gaps before they cost us.

• Track equipment and trailer positioning; coordinate rotation so assets are where they need to be.



Compliance Support

• Ensure daily check-in protocols, ELD readiness, and routing instructions are followed.

• Keep drivers on the right side of HOS and DOT requirements.



Risk Mitigation

• Proactively spot and solve issues before they escalate such as HOS conflicts, misrouted trucks, idle equipment, and coverage gaps.



Collaborative Execution

• Work alongside leadership, recruiting, and the brokerage/ops team to cover shifts and resolve issues in real time.



Operational Logging

• Maintain shift-level documentation, driver notes, trailer counts, and escalation logs for senior review.



What You'll Be Measured On

• Driver satisfaction and retention within your assigned group

• On-time dispatch and schedule adherence

• Tractor and trailer uptime; reduction of idle-asset time

• Response time to driver issues and operational i

• Communication clarity and escalation speed

• Adherence to SOPs, protocols, and dispatch audit standards



Qualifications

• 2+ years in asset-based dispatch, driver management, fleet coordination, or driver scheduling

• Experience with ELD platforms and routing/dispatch software

• Strong relationship skills to ensure drivers respect you and want to work with you

• Clear and assertive communicator who stays calm and decisive under pressure

• Comfortable in a live and fast-moving operational setting

• Schedule flexibility, including weekend and high volume window availability

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct Hire to US Company

• Full Time Role

• Permanent Work From Home

• Current Shift Need: To be confirmed

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and payroll

• Shifts may adjust based on operational demand



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 400+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data entry role. You're the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate and flags problems before they cost us time and money. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don't let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with dispatchers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, logistics coordination, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems (a plus)

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Monday - Friday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 3 PM - 1 AM CDT | Wednesday - Monday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Possible Shift (only if assigned): 11 PM - 9 AM CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

Our growth is driven by performance-focused creatives. Every ad we launch is built around data, direct-response principles, and a clear objective: generating profitable sales.



We are looking for a full-time Video Editor who does more than simply edit videos. You should think like a marketer, understand why an ad performs, and be motivated to create winning creatives at scale.



The Role



We are hiring a full-time Video Editor to produce high-performing video ads for Meta and Google.



Most videos will be between 30 and 120 seconds and may include UGC, VSLs, advertorial-style content, AI-generated visuals, voiceovers, b-roll, and direct-response storytelling.



This is a long-term, fully remote position with a fixed salary of $1,000 USD per month, plus a highly attractive performance-based bonus structure.



What You’ll Do



* Edit high-converting video ads for Meta and Google

* Create videos between 30 and 120 seconds

* Develop strong hooks, pacing, captions, transitions, and visual patterns

* Work with UGC footage, b-roll, stock footage, voiceovers, and AI-generated content

* Use tools such as HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, and Veo 3

* Produce UGC-style ads, TikTok-style creatives, VSLs, AI videos, and other direct-response formats

* Analyze performance data and improve creatives based on KPIs such as hook rate, hold rate, conversion rate, and ROAS

* Work closely with our Creative Manager, Creative Strategists, and other Video Editors

* Source relevant raw footage, b-roll, visuals, and voiceovers

* Test new formats, trends, angles, and storytelling structures

* Deliver approximately 15 new ad concepts per week

* Iterate quickly on winning creatives to produce new variations



What We’re Looking For



* Experience editing performance-driven Meta ads

* A strong portfolio of UGC, short-form, VSL, or direct-response video ads

* A clear understanding of hooks, consumer psychology, pacing, and storytelling

* The ability to identify why an ad is likely to convert

* Experience working with performance metrics and creative testing

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication and the ability to meet deadlines

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a high creative output

* Willingness to test, learn, receive feedback, and iterate quickly

* A long-term mindset and genuine motivation to grow with the company



What You’ll Get



* Fixed salary of $1,000 USD per month

* A highly attractive performance-based bonus structure

* Significant earning potential when your creatives perform

* A fully remote, long-term position

* Direct collaboration with experienced editors, strategists, and the founder

* Clear guidance and feedback from a dedicated Creative Manager

* Access to performance data so you can understand which creatives are winning

* Opportunities to develop your direct-response and performance-marketing skills

* Salary and responsibility growth based on performance



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A link to your portfolio

2. Examples of performance ads you have edited

3. Any available performance results from your previous creatives

4. A brief explanation of your experience with Meta ads, UGC, VSLs, and AI editing tools

5. Your current availability and preferred working hours



Applications without relevant video-ad examples will not be considered.

title: Social Media Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description:
About Us



We’re Ora Belize, a boutique marketing and web agency that works with destination wedding brands and boutique hospitality properties throughout Belize and the Caribbean.



We’re a small team that genuinely enjoys working together. We believe in clear communication, kindness, accountability, and operating with good intentions. We’re not looking for someone to simply complete tasks, we’re looking for the right person to become part of our team.



We handle the strategy, content planning, shot lists, copywriting, and client communication. Your role is to take those pieces and bring them to life through beautiful, polished content.



What You’ll Be Doing



• Edit short-form videos and reels using footage we provide

• Create Canva graphics and carousel posts using our brand assets and prepared copy

• Schedule and publish approved content using Metricool

• Follow our content calendar and creative briefs so you always know what’s coming next



What You Won’t Need To Do



• Come up with marketing strategies

• Write captions from scratch

• Communicate directly with clients

• Chase approvals or manage projects



Our goal is to let you focus on what you do best: creating high-quality content.



The Kind of Person We’re Looking For



We’re much more interested in finding the right person than checking every box on a résumé.



Ideally, you are someone who:



• Communicates openly and responds in a timely manner

• Is dependable and takes pride in doing great work

• Is flexible and comfortable working in a growing business where priorities occasionally shift

• Has a positive attitude and approaches challenges with good intentions

• Enjoys learning and improving over time

• Appreciates constructive feedback and collaboration



Our Style



Our brands are elegant, warm, and story-driven.



Think destination weddings, luxury travel, boutique resorts, and authentic experiences, not fast-paced viral edits or trend-based content.



If your editing style leans heavily toward TikTok trends, flashy transitions, or 
 content, this probably isn’t the right fit, and that’s completely okay. We’re simply looking for someone whose creative style aligns with the brands we serve.



Tools We Use



• Premiere Pro

• Canva

• Metricool

• Meta Business Suite

• Meta Ads Manager

• Claude



Hours & Growth



This position begins at approximately 15 hours per week.



We’re intentionally starting part-time because we want to build sustainably rather than overpromise. As our client base continues to grow, our hope is to grow this role into a full-time position for the right person.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow alongside us. We believe in creating stable, long-term opportunities and investing in people who are invested in the work.



Very Important To Get Hired

1. Work Samples: Include your work samples in the intro of your message and have it be relevant to our style

2. About You: Write us a little about you, what your strengths are and what you expect from this role.

3. Note: If you copy/paste generic a generic application without the 2 requirements above, you will not receive a reply from us

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable to fulfill this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person who contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Long-Term Wedding Photo Editor (Lightroom + Photoshop) – Detail-Oriented & Deadline Driven
description:
My name is Kayla and I am a Wedding & Portrait Photographer looking for a reliable freelance photo editor to help bring my images to life with careful attention to style, detail, and consistency for a part of this year, next year and years to come ideally!



I currently have at least 4 weddings to edit between March and April, plus 20 weddings booked for this year from May - November with sessions scattered throughout the year. This is the work I have guaranteed right now, but as I book more sessions and weddings, they will be added onto a task board right away so that you can see well in advance what I'll need help with and when it would be due, which will give you plenty of time to plan your life and other editing jobs accordingly around that.



As a heads up, I use an Ai editing tool to help me with the base edit so that the editing process is as efficient as possible. This means you would receive a Lightroom catalog with the images partially or mostly edited, but I still need help getting them fully completed through cropping, straightening, brush work, spot removal / eliminating distractions exposure + temperature correction, etc. and ensuring the images match my signature style.



Since the Ai editing tool will be taking care of the base edit, this means that it will take you less time per image to finish the edit to the standard I'm looking for since there will already be a base edit applied. For this reason, I'm looking for someone who can fine tune these images for $0.12 CAD per image. There will also be Photoshop retouching needed on a case by case basis, which includes advanced object removal and head swaps (only on selected images) and comes at an additional pay at $0.12 CAD per image.



Here is what I need help with:



-Fine tuning/editing about
+ photos per wedding in Lightroom using a preset I work with

-Using brush tool, graduated filters, cropping, straightening, and making sure the Al tool got the correct exposure and colour temperature (you will be trained on how I edit my photos)

- Object removal and head swaps using Photoshop on a case by case basis

*If you are disorganized or have difficulty with deadlines and structure, please do not apply. 

*If you can't take honest feedback well and can learn quickly from the feedback, please do not apply.

* If you have an unreliable internet connection, please do not apply.



What I'm looking for:

*Dedicated, Loyal, On-Time, Organized, Hits Deadlines, Detail Oriented, Creative, Quick Learner, strong in English

*Someone who is EXCITED to edit wedding and couples photos full of emotion and beauty 

*Ideally someone who could support me with having a 5-7 day turnaround time for weddings and a 2-3 business day turnaround time for sessions.



If this sounds like you and you'd love to connect more about this opportunity, reply to this job post with the following: your WhatsApp number, your
, let me know if you have Photoshop / Lightroom, let me know if you have a strong internet connection, why you love editing photos for other photographers, if $0.12 CAD per image works for you, examples of edited work you enjoyed editing, and an inspirational quote that makes you happy,



As a heads up, I will only be responding to applicants that I will select for the interview process, so if you don't hear back fro

title: Transportation Tracker
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties, with a primary focus on Memphis lanes. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

As an Transportation Tracker, you will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Support Memphis execution by closely monitoring Memphis lanes, driver movement, load progress, and service requirements

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, and customer requirements

• Monitor live fleet movement using GPS and TMS

• Track and update ETAs, check calls, timestamps, and delivery milestones in real time

• Enter, audit, and maintain accurate load data in Google Sheets and TMS

• Communicate continuously with drivers, brokers, and customers regarding status updates

• Identify delays, route conflicts, detention risks, or service issues and take proactive action

• Escalate operational risks to leadership when necessary

• Generate shift-based operational reports summarizing load activity, Memphis lane updates, and exceptions

• Follow dispatch, communication, and escalation SOPs consistently

• Maintain clean shift handoffs and organized documentation



What Success Looks Like

• Memphis lanes are monitored closely and executed with urgency, accuracy, and consistency

• TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms reflect complete and error-free data at all times

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

• Critical loads are monitored closely and handled with urgency from start to finish

• Communication is clear, concise, and actionable, both in written updates and verbal escalations

• Operational risks and issues are flagged early with solutions, not just problems

• Shift handoffs are smooth, complete, and well documented

• You become someone the team can depend on during high-pressure situations



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, or transportation tracking

• Understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and HOS awareness

• Familiar with US geography and US logistics trucking operations (a plus)

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously

• Understands urgency and prioritization in a live dispatch environment

• Communicates clearly and professionally via zoom, chat, and email

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Can monitor multiple loads at once without losing accuracy

• Pays strong attention to detail and uses sound judgment when issues arise

• Comfortable operating in high volume communication environments

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean execution

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance recognition and advancement potential



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct Hire to US Company

• Full Time Role

• Permanent Work From Home

• Current Shift Need: Monday - Friday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Other shifts (only if assigned): 3 PM - 1 AM CDT & 11 PM - 9 AM CDT

• Zoom presence (with camera open and unmuted audio) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

• Shifts may adjust based on operational demand



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute Memphis lanes with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

description:

While many companies simply check the required boxes when it comes to culture, a well-balanced team and positive office culture has been the core of our success from the start. We are a social team at heart, and that is one constant that hasn’t changed with all the movement this economy and industry has seen. We have embraced a hybrid work model where local tea
mbers come in at least two days a week. This allows us to work from home and have flexibility, without altogether forgoing the excitement and 
nts of collaboration and inspiration you can only get from in-person time. Not to mention, we also genuinely enjoy spending time together and socializing.



We celebrate new ideas and prioritize a culture of trust and respect where tea
mbers can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named:

San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in: 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies in: 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and 2026, San Diego Business Journal’s Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024, Inc Best Workplaces list in: 2024 and 2025, and Inc. 5000 for the last 6 years (
)!



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



Job Description

The Accounts Payable Associate is responsible for managing the end-to-end payables process at Wonderist Agency across both operating entities. This includes processing vendor invoices, reconciling statements, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining accurate financial records. This role works closely with the accounting team and executive suite and reports directly to Finance Operations Manager.



Key Responsibilities

Weekly

Review and process incoming vendor invoices across both entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing)

Match invoices to purchase orders or approvals and route for sign-off as needed

Respond to vendor inquiries regarding payment status within 24 hours

Log all payables in accounting software and ensure coding accuracy by department and entity

Flag any discrepancies, duplicate charges, or overbilling for resolution

Review and process approved employee expense reimbursements, ensuring proper coding and timely payment

Monitor and reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card transactions against receipts and coding by department and entity

Review and process contractor invoices, including 1099-eligible payments submitted via Rippling or directly by contractors

Attend weekly finance check-in with leadership; come prepared with a current AP snapshot including aged items, open disputes, and any items requiring a decision or escalation



Monthly

Reconcile vendor statements against internal records and resolve any variances

Prepare a monthly AP aging report

Process approved payment runs and confirm remittance details with vendors

Support month-end close by providing complete and accurate AP data

Maintain organized digital records of all invoices, approvals, and payment confirmations

Reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card statements against internal records and resolve any variances



Quarterly/As Needed

Assist with audit preparation by compiling AP documentation as requested

Identify opportunities to streamline AP workflows or improve vendor billing accuracy

Support annual 1099 preparation by maintaining accurate vendor payment records throughout the year

Participate in process improvement initiatives related to finance operations

Collect and maintain W-9s for all new vendors and contractors at time of onboarding; maintain accurate vendor master file to support 1099 preparation

Support annual 1099 preparation for all eligible vendors and contractors, including payments processed via Rippling and direct invoice



Performance Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

Invoice processing accuracy (target: 99%+)

On-time payment execution with no missed due dates

AP aging report delivery on schedule each month

Vendor dispute resolution time

Quality and completeness of records for month-end close



Essential Functions: What You’ll Do

Invoice Processing and Payment Execution: Review, code, and process vendor invoices with accuracy and urgency. Ensure all invoices are matched to proper approvals before payment. Execute payment runs on schedule and confirm remittance with vendors as appropriate.

Vendor Relationship Management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for vendor billing inquiries. Maintain professional and responsive communication to protect vendor relationships while advocating for Wonderist's financial interests when discrepancies arise.

Discrepancy Resolution: Identify and investigate billing errors, duplicate charges, and overbilling situations. Document disputes clearly, communicate with vendors to reach resolution, and ensure credits or corrections are reflected accurately in the system.

Record Keeping and Reporting: Maintain complete and organized AP records in the accounting system. Produce monthly aging reports and provide data to support month-end close, audits, and leadership reporting as needed.

Cross-Entity Coordination: Manage payables across both operating entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing), applying accurate entity coding and maintaining clear separation of records.

Rippling Spend and Expense Management: Reconcile corporate card transactions in Rippling Spend and process employee reimbursement requests. Ensure all card activity is coded accurately by department and entity and that receipts and approvals are documented.

Inter-Entity Transactions: Support accurate coding and reconciliation of any shared costs or allocated expenses across Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing, maintaining clear separation of records between entities.



Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Attention to Detail: You catch errors before they become problems. You verify totals, check coding, and review statements line by line. Nothing gets processed without confirmation.

Integrity: You handle sensitive financial information with discretion and operate with a high standard of accuracy and honesty.

Organization and Follow-Through: You manage a high volume of invoices and vendor communications without letting anything fall through the cracks. You maintain clear records and follow up proactively.

Communication and Professionalism: You correspond clearly and professionally with vendors and internal tea
mbers. You escalate issues with the right information and context so they can be resolved quickly.

Systems Proficiency: You are comfortable working in accounting software and picking up new tools. Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms is essential. Experience with Rippling Spend, 
, or similar platforms is a plus



Must-Have Qualifications

2+ years of accounts payable or bookkeeping experience

Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar

Strong command of written English for vendor and internal communication

High attention to detail and comfort working with high-volume invoice environments

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

Reliable internet connection and ability to work during Pacific Time business hours (partial overlap required)

Payment execution authority will be granted by leadership up to an approved threshold; comfort initiating and confirming payment runs within those parameters is required



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)

Experience supporting multi-entity accounting environments

Familiarity with Rippling, Ramp, 
, or similar platforms

Background in agency, marketing, or professional services environments

Experience with 1099 preparation and vendor compliance



This is a Full-Time Salaried position. This role is structured as an EOR agreement with Rippling EOR and Wonderist Agency.

title: Insurance Billing Specialist
description:
Summary

# Contract Revenue Cycle Biller



**Contract Position | Remote | Behavioral Health Revenue Cycle (RTC, PHP, and IOP)**



## Overview



The Hope Group operates multiple behavioral health care businesses, serving more than 100 clients at any given time. We are seeking a highly competent Contract Revenue Cycle Biller to manage billing and accounts receivable for approximately 20 active clients.



Most client funding comes from commercial insurance. However, some clients may be funded through school districts, state agencies, private pay arrangements, or other contracted funding sources. This role is responsible for making sure each funding source is billed accurately, invoices and claims are submitted on time, and payments are collected and properly recorded.



This position is critical to maintaining financial health and preventing administrative issues from disrupting client care. The ideal candidate has strong behavioral health billing experience, is highly organized and proactive, and can independently manage accounts from initial authorization or funding verification through final payment.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Insurance Billing and Claims Management



* Submit accurate and timely insurance claims for RTC, PHP, and IOP services

* Ensure proper coding, modifiers, rates, and documentation alignment before submission

* Monitor claim status and proactively resolve denials, rejections, and underpayments

* Track claims through full payment resolution

* Maintain clean and organized billing records for all clients



### School District, State, and Private Pay Billing



* Prepare and submit invoices to school districts, state agencies, families, and other funding partners

* Confirm billing rates, service dates, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documentation

* Track invoices from submission through payment

* Follow up on overdue balances and resolve missing documentation or payment issues

* Maintain clear records of payer requirements, billing contacts, and payment terms



### Utilization Review and Authorizations



* Obtain and manage pre-authorizations for covered services

* Submit concurrent and continued-stay reviews to insurance companies

* Track authorization dates, units, service limits, and expiration timelines

* Coordinate with clinical staff to obtain necessary documentation

* Help verify that services remain aligned with payer and funding requirements



### Accounts Receivable Management



* Perform ongoing follow-up with insurance companies and other funding sources

* Identify and escalate billing issues early to prevent aging balances

* Maintain low accounts receivable aging through proactive management

* Reconcile payments, adjustments, EOBs, remittance notices, and outstanding balances

* Ensure all accounts have a clear next action and expected payment timeline



### Insurance Paneling and Credentialing Support



* Assist with insurance paneling applications and renewals

* Maintain credentialing records and documentation

* Track panel status and help ensure continuity of network participation



### Coordination, Tracking, and Communication



* Communicate clearly with leadership regarding billing status, collection risks, and unresolved issues

* Collaborate with clinical and operational staff to ensure documentation supports billing requirements

* Maintain accurate tracking by client, payer, funding source, invoice, claim, and payment status

* Provide regular reporting on billing performance, outstanding balances, aging, denials, and risks



## Expected Scope



* Approximately 20 active clients

* Primarily commercial insurance billing

* Additional billing to school districts, state agencies, private pay families, and other funding sources

* Primarily RTC, with some PHP and IOP services

* Ongoing monthly billing, follow-up, utilization management, invoicing, and collections

* Flexible hours, with consistent weekly engagement required



## Required Qualifications



* Minimum two years of behavioral health billing or revenue cycle experience

* RTC billing experience strongly preferred

* Proven experience working with commercial insurance providers

* Strong experience with pre-authorizations, utilization review, and denial resolution

* Experience managing claims or invoices through the full lifecycle, from submission through payment

* Experience managing accounts receivable and following up on aging balances



## Technical Skills



* Strong understanding of behavioral health billing workflows

* Knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, modifiers, and payer-specific billing requirements

* Familiarity with insurance portals, clearinghouses, claims systems, and invoicing tools

* Ability to manage multiple funding structures, rates, contracts, and payment terms

* Strong organizational, reconciliation, and tracking skills



## Personal Attributes



* Highly detail-oriented

* Proactive and responsive

* Strong ownership mentality

* Persistent and professional in payment follow-up

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Clear and professional communicator



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience billing school districts, state agencies, Medicaid programs, or government contracts

* Experience with private pay invoicing and collections

* Experience billing for transitional living or outpatient behavioral health programs

* Experience with credentialing and insurance paneling

* Familiarity with the Utah behavioral health funding and insurance landscape

* Experience working in contract or outsourced billing roles



## Position Details



* Contract position (1099)

* Remote work

* Flexible hours



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* Claims and invoices submitted accurately and on time

* Authorizations obtained without interruption to care

* Minimal claim denials and fast resolution when denials occur

* School district, state, and private pay invoices collected within agreed payment terms

* Low accounts receivable aging across all funding sources

* Every outstanding balance has a documented next action

* Leadership has clear visibility into billing, collections, and payment risks at all times

title: Video Editor – Instagram Reels & YouTube (German-Language Fitness Content)
description:
We're an online fitness coaching brand looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team long-term, part-time.



YOUR MAIN JOB

Edit short-form Instagram Reels (and later, longer YouTube videos) for a German-speaking fitness/nutrition coach.



IMPORTANT — ALL RAW FOOTAGE IS IN GERMAN

You do not need to speak German. Before editing, you will use a transcription + translation tool (e.g. Descript, otter.ai, or similar, combined with Google Translate/DeepL) to transcribe the German audio and translate it into English. This lets you understand exactly what's being said and what the video is about, so you can make smart editing decisions (hooks, cuts, pacing) even without understanding German directly. This step is required for every video.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Rough-cut raw talking-head footage: remove filler words, dead air, and retakes; keep only the cleanest take

- Craft strong hooks in the first 1-3 seconds (text overlays, zoom-ins, pattern interrupts)

- Add b-roll, styled burned-in captions/subtitles, sound design, and simple motion graphics

- Follow an established visual style/template once trained on it

- Deliver polished vertical Reels (9:16) and, later, longer-form YouTube videos (16:9)

- Turn videos around quickly and reliably; communicate proactively if anything is unclear



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience editing short-form content (Reels/TikTok/Shorts) — please share a portfolio or reel of your best edits

- Strong sense for pacing, hooks, and what keeps viewers watching

- Comfortable using transcription/translation tools to work with non-English (German) audio

- Skilled in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar (please tell us which tool you use)

- Reliable internet connection and own equipment

- Good written English communication



This is a part-time, long-term role with room to grow into more responsibility (e.g. YouTube long-form editing) as we scale.



TO APPLY

Please include 2-3 examples of Reels or short-form videos you've edited (before/after clips are a big plus), and tell us which editing software you use.

title: Lead Platform Engineer — Internal Operations Platform
description:
Eagle Production Co. | Wall Township, NJ (Hybrid or Remote for the right candidate) | Full-Time



About Eagle Production Co.

Eagle Production Co. is a nationwide AV equipment rental and production company based in New Jersey, running for over a decade. 



We rent and support audio, video, lighting, rigging, and power equipment for events across the country — from corporate premieres to touring productions.



Over the past year we’ve built something most companies our size don’t have: a full custom operations platform that runs the business — CRM, quoting, invoicing, payments, inventory availability, COI compliance, crew staffing, payroll support, fleet logistics, and customer/freelancer/driver portals. It was built fast using AI-assisted development (Lovable + Supabase), it’s live, it processes real money, and it works.

Now it needs an owner.



The Role

You will take over our platform as its dedicated engineer and technical owner. This is not a greenfield job and it’s not maintenance-only — it’s both harder and more interesting than either. You’ll inherit a large, live, AI-built codebase (~700 files, 150+ Supabase edge functions, 100+ database tables) and be responsible for three things:

 1. Keep it stable. New features have historically broken existing ones. You’ll change that — with tests around the money logic, disciplined releases, and real code review of every change, whether written by you or by AI tools.

 2. Keep it moving. The feature roadmap doesn’t stop. You’ll ship new functionality weekly, working directly with the CEO, using AI-assisted development where it’s fast and hand-written code where it’s right.

 3. Lead the migration off Flex Rental Solutions. Our inventory and operations still run partly on Flex. Over the next phases of our roadmap, this platform becomes the single hub for all company operations. You’ll architect and execute that migration — inventory, scanning, availability, warehouse workflows — without disrupting live operations.



What You’ll Do

 • Own the full stack: React/TypeScript frontend, Supabase backend (Postgres, RLS, edge functions, storage, cron), and the integrations around them (payment processing, QuickBooks, Gmail, Flex API, HubSpot, shipping/logistics APIs)

 • Stabilize and harden the existing codebase: eliminate duplicate logic, add a test suite around pricing, tax, invoicing, and payment flows, and close security gaps (RLS coverage, endpoint auth, storage policies)

 • Build new features end to end from CEO-defined requirements — often same-week turnaround

 • Plan and execute the Flex migration in phases: data model, sync strategy, cutover plan, rollback plan

 • Establish engineering discipline that survives AI-assisted development: GitHub-based workflow, pre-change audits, batched changes, post-change verification

 • Support the team using the platform daily (sales, warehouse, finance, HR) — triage issues fast, communicate clearly with non-technical users

 • Document what you build so the company is never dependent on any one tool or person

What We’re Looking For



Required:

 • 5+ years full-stack experience with deep React + TypeScript

 • Strong PostgreSQL, including Row-Level Security, and hands-on Supabase (or equivalent: Firebase + SQL, Hasura, etc.)

 • Experience owning a production system that handles real money — payments, invoicing, or e-commerce — and the paranoia that comes with it

 • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Copilot or similar) AND the judgment to review, constrain, and correct what those tools produce. We work AI-first here; we don’t work AI-blind.

 • Experience integrating third-party APIs (payment gateways, accounting,
)

 • Ability to work directly with a fast-moving, hands-on CEO: translate business requirements into working software quickly, push back when something is a bad idea, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain English

Strongly preferred:

 • Experience inheriting and stabilizing a large existing codebase (rescue/refactor work)

 • Migration experience: replacing a legacy system of record without downtime

 • Testing discipline: Vitest/Jest, and knowing what’s worth testing in a business app

Nice to have:

 • Rental, events, AV, or logistics industry exposure

 • Flex Rental Solutions, QuickBooks API, or Cardknox/payment gateway experience

 • Mobile/PWA experience (our warehouse runs barcode scanning on the platform)

What This Job Is Not

 • Not a junior role with AI doing the thinking — AI writes a lot of first drafts here; you own correctness

 • Not a big-company pace — decisions happen in hours, not sprints

 • Not siloed — you’ll talk to warehouse staff, salespeople, and the CEO in the same day

Compensation & Details

 • Salary: based on experience,

 • Tagging and segmentation. A clean, logical CRM structure where every tag means something and our lists can actually be trusted.

 and SMS that run on their own and move people toward our programs, events, and retreats. Welcome, reactivation, and post-event flows that don’t need us to press send.

 scenarios running.

Week to week



 • Support our weekly Tuesday webinar loop: after each one, update the landing page and ads and adjust the next campaign

 deliverability, not just
 sending

How we work



Part-time, long-term, remote, deliverable-based. Required team huddles Mon 9am EST and Tue, Thu, Fri 9:30am EST. We start with one small paid test build before committing long term.
